a41aa10b2a1984644dba.title: Patients Care Coordinator
a41aa10b2a1984644dba.description:
Genesis PHCM is a physician-led healthcare platform built to expand access to care through a modern, patient-centered model. Our foundation is virtual-first, providing 24/7 telehealth services to patients across the United States, while expanding our services onsite through urgent care and a Primary Care Clinic.

We are seeking an organized, proactive, and patient-focused Patients Care Coordinator to help turn prospective patient interest into scheduled appointments and make accessing Genesis’s services as simple as possible.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently, building processes from the ground up, and contributing ideas and best practices within a growing healthcare organization.

This role will report to the Executive Operations Lead and will manage patient follow-up, scheduling, and lead tracking through existing electronic medical record (EMR) systems. They will also support patient recruitment and assigned healthcare partnership outreach, helping ensure every prospective patient has a clear next step.

* Manage incoming patient inquiries and assigned leads from healthcare fairs, referral partners, and digital campaigns, completing timely follow-ups and documenting outcomes
* Guide prospective patients from initial interest through scheduling, answer non-clinical questions, explain appointment procedures using approved service information and pricing, and route clinical questions to the appropriate provider
* Monitor incoming communications, outreach history, prospect engagement levels, and pending outreach tasks while handling booking, verification, and calendar modifications with precision
* Support patient recruitment within assigned markets and audiences, including busy professionals, remote workers, frequent travelers, small businesses, and senior communities
* Support healthcare partnership outreach by researching organizations, identifying appropriate contacts, arranging discussions, and completing assigned follow-ups under the Executive Operations Lead’s direction
* Help establish patient lead and scheduling workflows, document procedures, and identify recurring barriers that prevent interested patients from booking appointments
* Conduct routine audits of patient charts to identify documentation gaps, ensure clinical accuracy, and support optimal billing workflow

**Performance Expectations (Key Results)**
------------------------------------------

Within this role, expected outcomes include:

* Establish a clear patient lead workflow from initial inquiry through contact, follow-up, scheduling, and appointment
* Maintain accurate records so every assigned lead has a documented status, outreach outcome, and next step
* Use EMR system confidently to manage inquiries and complete accurate patient scheduling
* Establish consistent follow-up procedures for leads from events, partnerships, and digital campaigns
* Track response times, follow-up completion, appointment bookings, and lead-to-appointment conversion, and recommend improvements

  
**Requirements**  

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Experience working in a remote startup or similarly fast-paced, evolving environment
* Availability to provide approximately 30 hours of support per week
* Availability for company-wide meetings and collaboration, when needed, between 10:00 AM and 12:30 PM Pacific Time
* Experience in patient coordination, medical scheduling, healthcare administration, patient outreach, or a related patient-facing role
* Experience following up with prospective patients, managing inquiries, and helping individuals complete appointment scheduling or other next steps
* Experience using an electronic medical record (EMR), practice management platform, CRM, or similar system to maintain accurate records and track follow-ups
* Strong communication, follow-through, organizational, and recordkeeping skills, with a warm and professional approach to patient interactions
* Ability to explain non-clinical information clearly, recognize questions requiring clinical input, and handle confidential patient information appropriately in compliance with HIPAA guidelines
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and coordinate effectively with internal team members and external contacts

### **Preferred Requirements**

* Experience using PatientPop and Tebra
* Experience supporting telehealth services or a primary care practice
* Experience developing patient intake, follow-up, scheduling, or lead-management workflows and SOPs
* Experience supporting healthcare partnership outreach, community events, or follow-up with leads generated through digital campaigns
* Full fluency in Spanish, both spoken and written
* Interest in building a long-term relationship with Genesis as the organization grows

  
**Benefits**  

* Approximately **30 hours per week**
* **Flexible working hours** outside of required meetings and collaboration needs
* Fully remote engagement
* Potential opportunity to transition from a freelance engagement to **W-2 employment** as Genesis grows, based on business needs and mutual fit

e0cd79cc1946e1f1b752.title: On-Site Administrative Assistant
e0cd79cc1946e1f1b752.description:
An Administrative Assistant plays a vital role in delivering exceptional service to homeowners, Board Members, and vendors while helping ensure each community operates efficiently and effectively. Working alongside the Community Manager, this position helps coordinate daily operations, respond to resident needs, manage projects, and support Board initiatives that enhance the quality and value of the communities we serve.

If you're highly organized, enjoy building relationships, and thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact while growing your career in community association management. You'll be part of a collaborative team that values ownership, problem-solving, and outstanding customer service, all while helping create communities that residents are proud to call home.

 **Compensation:**

$45,000 - $50,000 yearly

 **Responsibilities:**

**Community Operations & Administrative Support**

* Partner with the Community Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of assigned communities, ensuring a high level of service and organization.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date homeowner records, governing documents, correspondence, contracts, and community files.
* Prepare reports, correspondence, and administrative documents while ensuring timely follow-up on outstanding items.
* Support special projects and initiatives that enhance community operations and resident satisfaction.

**Board & Resident Communication**

* Serve as a professional point of contact for homeowners, Board Members, and vendors, delivering responsive and solution-oriented customer service.
* Draft, coordinate, and distribute community communications, including newsletters, notices, meeting announcements, and policy updates.
* Build positive relationships with stakeholders by providing timely information and maintaining open lines of communication.

**Board Meeting & Governance Support**

* Coordinate and attend Board Meetings, Annual Meetings, and other Association events as required.
* Prepare meeting agendas, management reports, resolutions, and supporting documentation.
* Record and distribute meeting minutes and ensure action items are tracked through completion.
* Assist Boards in implementing decisions while ensuring compliance with governing documents and established procedures.

**Community Standards & Compliance**

* Support the enforcement of Association governing documents, rules, and architectural standards in a fair and consistent manner.
* Conduct follow-up on violations and work collaboratively with homeowners to achieve voluntary compliance whenever possible.
* Maintain accurate compliance records and coordinate with legal counsel or vendors when appropriate.

**Vendor & Project Coordination**

* Coordinate with contractors and service providers to schedule maintenance, repairs, inspections, and community improvement projects.
* Solicit, compare, and evaluate vendor proposals to help identify cost-effective and high-quality solutions.
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure contracted services are completed in accordance with Association expectations.

**Financial & Budget Administration**

* Assist with the preparation of annual budgets, financial reports, and Board presentation materials.
* Review and process invoices, verify coding, and coordinate vendor payments in accordance with Association policies.
* Support assessment collection efforts by monitoring delinquent accounts and coordinating with collection agencies or legal counsel as directed.
* Help Boards make informed financial decisions by providing organized and accurate financial information.

**Homeowner Experience**

* Respond to homeowner inquiries, requests, and concerns with professionalism, empathy, and a commitment to excellent customer service.
* Facilitate the resolution of resident concerns and neighbor disputes while promoting positive community relationships.
* Provide guidance on Association policies, procedures, and available resources to enhance the homeowner experience.

**Records Management**

* Maintain organized electronic and physical records, including resident information, financial documents, contracts, governing documents, and Board records.
* Ensure documentation is accurate, confidential, and readily accessible for operational and compliance needs.

**Emergency & Risk Management**

* Support the Community Manager in responding to emergencies, service interruptions, and other unexpected events affecting the community.
* Coordinate communication with Board Members, residents, vendors, and emergency service providers during critical situations.
* Assist in documenting incidents and following through on recovery efforts to minimize disruption to the community.

**Professional Growth & Team Collaboration**

* Work collaboratively with Community Managers and internal departments to deliver exceptional service and achieve company objectives.
* Continuously develop industry knowledge and management skills while embracing opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
* Demonstrate accountability, adaptability, and a proactive approach to problem-solving in a fast-paced environment.

 **Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or GED required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Communications, Property Management, or a related field preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience in customer service, administrative support, office management, property management, or a related professional environment.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with homeowners, Board Members, vendors, and colleagues.
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams) and the ability to quickly learn new software platforms.
* Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive information.
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation for travel to community meetings and site inspections as needed.

 **About Company**

CAMCO Property Management is an equal-opportunity employer committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), age, sexual orientation, national origin, marital status, parental status, ancestry, disability, gender identity, veteran status, genetic information, other distinguishing characteristics of diversity and inclusion, or any other protected status. Qualified applicants with arrest and/or conviction records will be considered for employment in a manner consistent with federal and state laws, as well as applicable local ordinances. All offers of employment with CAMCO Property Management are contingent upon a satisfactory background check.

At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

*LifeStance Health Values*

* Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.
* Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.
* Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.
* One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

*Benefits*  
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.

**Job Summary:**

The Practice Coordinator is responsible for managing the front office daily activities for their practice location, ensuring quality customer service to in-person and remote patients and clinicians.

  

**Compensation:** Starting at $21.00/hourly, plus quarterly bonus/incentive potential

**Location**: 600 Evergreen Drive Suite 103 Glen Mills, PA 19342

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

**Operational Excellence:**

* Create a positive work environment; be a culture carrier and support in-office clinician and staff engagement activities to promote LFST culture, engagement, and connection.
* Conduct schedule prep process for all patients to ensure all paperwork and documentation is complete, credit card on file is current, demographics are accurate, and patient chart is prepared.
* General office duties, cleanliness, and appeal, such as sorting office mail, scanning documents, e-faxes, shared office email and office upkeep, to ensure the practice is running smoothly and prepared for patients and clinicians.
* Communicate with peers, clinicians, and patients in ways that support patient care and clinician satisfaction.

**Patient Support:**

* Provide exceptional customer service, responding quickly and appropriately to patient needs, and being prepared to manage potentially difficult or sensitive situations by following Crisis and De-escalation Processes.
* Manage front desk responsibilities including greeting and checking patients in/out in a courteous manner.
* Provide support to patients with requests via phone, email, and/or portal with payment/billing related questions, scheduling needs, release requests, miscellaneous inquires, etc.
* Manage queues within the phone system, ensuring calls are answered timely to ensure excellent customer service.
* Assist patients with telehealth access, Patient Portal issues, and other troubleshooting as needed.

* Handle any urgent requests; triage patient issues and resolution, i.e., direct to correct departments or escalate for assistance.
* Collect all in-person and telehealth co-payments and account balances at the time of service.
* Complete insurance eligibility verification and reach out to patients to resolve any issues.

**Clinician Support:**

* Provide general clinician support – assist clinicians with administrative questions and/or duties such as sending letters, faxes, etc.
* Coordinate with clinicians pertaining to any additional patient questions.
* Support clinician schedules by auditing for appointment accuracy.
* Maintain a pleasant, secure, and motivational working environment in the Practice.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Ability to multitask and prioritize duties to support delivery of high-quality patient experience.
* Ability to work independently and as a team member.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Proficient in using Computer Software Applications (Microsoft Office & EMRs)
* Comfortable handling sensitive and confidential Information (HIPAA)

**Education and Experience:**

* High School or equivalent required, associates/bachelor’s degree, preferred.
* 1+ years of experience in healthcare operations, customer service, or similar role or setting preferred.

**Physical Requirements:**

* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, bend, talk, and hear. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee must be able to lift and/or move objects up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

5a1d7126644e32e336eb.description:
SHIFT:

Day (United States of America)

**Seeking Breakthrough Makers**  
  
Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) offers countless ways to change lives. Our diverse community of more than 20,000 Breakthrough Makers will inspire you to pursue passions, develop expertise, and drive innovation.
  
  
At CHOP, your experience is valued; your voice is heard; and your contributions make a difference for patients and families. Join us as we build on our promise to advance pediatric care—and your career.  
  
  
  
CHOP does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, national origin, religion, or any other legally protected categories in any employment, training, or vendor decisions or programs. CHOP recognizes the critical importance of a workforce rich in varied backgrounds and experiences and engages in ongoing efforts to achieve that through equally varied and non-discriminatory means.  
  
**A Brief Overview**  
PSRs serve as the operational gateway to care delivery, helping ensure patients and families experience a seamless, informed, and compassionate entry into the healthcare system while supporting access and overall financial integrity.  
  
PSRs are responsible for supporting patient access, registration accuracy, financial clearance, and service excellence. This role plays a critical part in patient experience, operational flow, and revenue integrity across the organization. Team members serve as trusted guides for patients and families while partnering closely with clinical and operational teams to ensure efficient, accurate, and compassionate service delivery. Other duties, administrative support, and projects as required.

  

**Location:** CHOP Pediatric Primary Care, CHOP Campus

**Address:** 3550 Market St 4th Floor, Philadelphia, PA 19104

**Work Schedule**: (Full-Time)

* Three days per week, 10:30 AM–7:00 PM
* Two days per week, 9:00 AM–5:30 PM
* Some weekend and holiday coverage is required from 8:00 AM–12:00 PM.

**What you will do**

* Provide welcoming, prompt, and respectful customer service, which includes scheduling and registering appointments, informing of delays, addressing family complaints, and escalating complaints as necessary.
* Perform PARC (PATIENT ACCESS & REVENUE CYCLE) EPIC functions while ensuring accuracy, and run daily eligibility verifications, following organization access and intake standards.
* Reconciliation of daily services to include collection and processing of payments received, reimbursements, creating and/or obtaining insurance referrals and authorizations needed. Communicate financial responsibility to patients/families.
* For sites responsible for incoming/outbound calls: Answer phones promptly with minimal downtime between calls, monitor call service levels, accurately verify and document contact information and messages, and provide appropriate information to callers as warranted. Communicate in a courteous, caring manner to all customers as needed. Check voicemails if applicable for your site.
* Communicate with patients and families in accordance with CHOP's iCARE values.
* Escalate workflow issues and family issues as appropriate. Provide Family Relations contact information to families if needed.
* Offer and support families with MyCHOP activation for enrollment and troubleshooting of the portal. Encourage utilization of pre-check to support efficient and prompt check-in.
* Perform administrative tasks as assigned such as sorting and delivering mail, faxes (RightFax), medical records, and other correspondence; and photocopying and faxing documents. Scan, upload, and route documents accurately while safeguarding PHI.
* Daily maintenance of patient records and daily schedules while adhering to CHOP policy and procedure, and upholding all HIPAA and documentation standards.
* Actively participate in team huddles and meetings.
* Clean and maintain an organized workspace and ensure that waiting areas are kept tidy as needed.
* Completion of necessary work queues as assigned and various other daily reports.
* Maintain and monitor key performance metrics to ensure goals are met, resources are used effectively, and operational performance is consistently achieved.
* PSRs may need to cover and rotate to other sites and locations. Location and hours may vary. If shifts or staffing needs are available at other locations, PSRs will be asked to support and cover open shifts as needed.

**Education Qualifications**

* High School Diploma/GED - Required

**Experience Qualifications**

* At least one (1) year Patient Services Representative experience in a role that consisted of health care, registration, physician billing, medical records, medical office work and relatable customer service - Preferred

**Skills and Abilities**

* Good verbal and written communications skills. (Required proficiency)
* Good interpersonal skills. (Required proficiency)
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism (Required proficiency)

f8ad9fb9e39e87594143.title: Behavioral Health Sales & Customer Support Sr Specialist - Hybrid (PA/NJ/DE)
f8ad9fb9e39e87594143.description:
Bring your drive for excellence, teamwork, and customer commitment to Independence. Join us as we renew and reimagine the future of health care. Together we will achieve our mission to enhance the health and well-being of the people and communities we serve.

The Behavioral Health Performance Manager is responsible for driving operational performance, issue resolution, and change management across the Behavioral Health (BH) organization’s service, product, billing, vendor, provider, and network functions. The Performance Manager serves as an operational anchor and cross-functional problem-solver—owning escalation oversight, coordinating multi-departmental resolution, and ensuring that provider-, claims-, and regulatory-related issues are addressed accurately, timely, and to closure.

Serving as a central interface between BH business leadership, operations, and enterprise partners, the Performance Manager oversees service, product, billing, and vendor change management; supports client setup and configuration accuracy; manages claim and accounts-receivable (AR) escalations; oversees provider data quality, credentialing, and network stabilization; and coordinates the resolution of executive-level regulatory and complaint matters. The role ensures BH operational commitments are met while maintaining compliance, access, and a high standard of provider and member experience.

This role collaborates closely with Behavioral Health Business Leadership, BH Operations, Provider Network and Provider Data Management, Credentialing, Claims, Configuration, Vendor Management, Policy, Compliance, and Government/Regulatory Affairs to keep operations stable, issues resolved, and stakeholders aligned.

**Key Responsibilities**

Service, Product, Billing & Vendor Change Management

* Lead change management for behavioral health service, product, billing, and vendor changes, ensuring updates are planned, coordinated, communicated, and implemented with minimal operational disruption.
* Support client setup and configuration accuracy, partnering with operations and configuration teams to validate setup, prevent errors, and resolve discrepancies.

Claims Oversight & Escalation Resolution

* Provide claim escalation oversight and coordinate troubleshooting tools and workflows to identify root causes, expedite corrections, and prevent recurring issues.
* Manage claims issue resolution and accounts-receivable (AR)–related escalations, working across claims, finance, and provider teams to drive timely and accurate resolution.

Provider Data & Network Management

* Oversee provider data management—including directory accuracy and ongoing data cleanup—to ensure reliable, compliant provider information across systems and member-facing directories.
* Support contract stabilization and monitor provider access and availability, escalating gaps that could affect network adequacy or member access to care.
* Manage network escalations (e.g., Provider Payment Advocacy / PPA issues) and provide network development support to strengthen and stabilize the behavioral health provider network.

Credentialing & Provider Relations

* Oversee and resolve credentialing escalations, coordinating with credentialing and provider teams to keep providers active, compliant, and appropriately enrolled.
* Lead provider relations and communications (including Connect-to-Care / C2C efforts), serving as a responsive point of contact for provider inquiries and concerns.
* Coordinate provider manual updates and related communications, ensuring providers receive accurate, timely guidance on policies, processes, and changes.

Regulatory & Executive Issue Resolution

* Coordinate resolution of executive-level regulatory issues and provider complaints, including PID (Pennsylvania Insurance Department), DOBI (NJ Department of Banking and Insurance), and DOL (Department of Labor) matters, ensuring accurate, timely, and well-documented responses.
* Serve as a cross-functional liaison to resolve multi-departmental issues (e.g., PPA, Claims, Policy), convening the right stakeholders, driving accountability, and tracking issues through to closure.

General Operational Oversight

* Maintain issue logs, escalation trackers, and status reporting across the BH operational portfolio, ensuring visibility, follow-through, and executive readiness.
* Identify recurring problems and drive process improvements that reduce escalations, improve accuracy, and enhance provider and member experience.
* Maintain compliance with HIPAA, CMS, state regulations, and company policies regarding member and provider information and data privacy.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Health Informatics, or a related field required.
* Master’s degree (e.g., MHA, MBA, MPH) preferred.

**Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in healthcare, managed care, or behavioral health, including operations, provider network, claims, or business performance management.
* Demonstrated experience managing escalations, change management, or cross-functional issue resolution, ideally within a health plan or integrated delivery setting.
* Experience with provider data management, credentialing, claims, or configuration processes strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting commercial, Medicare Advantage, and/or Medicaid lines of business preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook) and collaboration/tracking tools (e.g., Teams, Planner, Smartsheet).
* Familiarity with claims, provider data, credentialing, and configuration systems, as well as troubleshooting and issue-tracking tools.
* Working knowledge of provider network operations, billing, and regulatory/complaint processes (e.g., PID, DOBI, DOL).

**Competencies**

* Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills, with the ability to resolve complex, multi-departmental issues to closure.
* Exceptional organizational and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent escalations and priorities.
* Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills across business leadership, operations, provider, and external audiences.
* Sound judgment, ownership, and the ability to operate calmly and decisively in a fast-paced, escalation-driven environment.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy in data, documentation, and regulatory responses.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within a health insurance company, managed care organization, or behavioral health managed care organization.
* Knowledge of provider network development, credentialing, claims/AR, and provider data management practices.
* Familiarity with regulatory and complaint-resolution processes across Pennsylvania and New Jersey (e.g., PID, DOBI, DOL).
* Process-improvement credential (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma) or project management certification (e.g., PMP, CAPM).

**Success Measures**

* Timely, high-quality resolution of claims, provider data, credentialing, and network escalations.
* Effective coordination of service, product, billing, and vendor changes with minimal operational disruption.
* Accurate, compliant provider data and directories, with measurable reductions in recurring errors and complaints.
* Prompt, well-documented resolution of executive-level regulatory (PID/DOBI/DOL) and provider complaint matters.
* Strong stakeholder satisfaction and demonstrable contribution to BH operational stability and performance.

**Hybrid**

Independence has implemented a “Hybrid” model which consists of Associates working in the office 3 days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday) and remotely 2 days a week (Monday & Friday). This role is designated as a role that fits into the “Hybrid” model. While associates may work remotely on our designated remote days, the work must be performed in the Tri-State Area of Delaware, New Jersey or Pennsylvania.

* Contacts patients to schedule complex and/or interventional radiology procedures.

**Everyone Is a Caregiver**
===========================

At UMass Memorial Health, everyone is a caregiver – regardless of their title or responsibilities. Exceptional patient care, academic excellence and leading-edge research make UMass Memorial the premier health system of Central Massachusetts, and a place where we can help you build the career you deserve. We are more than 20,000 employees, working together as one health system in a relentless pursuit of healing for our patients, community and each other. And everyone, in their own unique way, plays an important part, every day.

The role of the Patient Access Scheduling Agent is the front door for patients to secure access to the right care, at the right time, with the right provider. The Patient Access Scheduling agent performs a variety of complex scheduling activities that ensures patients get access to the care they need by providing exceptional patient service.

I. Major Responsibilities:
  
1. Handles incoming phone calls from patients, families and referring providers to schedule patient appointments. Scheduling scope includes multiple providers across multiple clinics/departments, practices across multiple campuses.
  
2. Makes outbound phone calls to patients to schedule appointments with specialists and subspecialists.
  
3. As part of the appointment scheduling process, secure the information needed to facilitate the financial aspects of medical care such as patient demographics (name, date of birth, etc.), insurance information, and account guarantor. Processes updates and corrections to patient insurance and demographic information. Collects patient liabilities prior to or on the date of service, as appropriate.
  
4. Based upon appointment visit type, secure medical records from outside health care organizations to ensure the provider has the necessary medical information to provide care.
  
5. Schedules in office procedures (such as biopsies, etc.), which often requires scheduling the appointment and scheduling the room where the procedure will take place.
  
6. Applies relevant functional knowledge of multiple treatment areas, the priority and sequence of associated procedures, tests and primary care services.
  
7. Prioritizes visits and services in a manner that will foster more efficient utilization of physician’s clinical staff, and patient’s time, as well as equipment and facilities.

Standard Staffing Level Responsibilities:
  
1. Complies with established departmental policies, procedures and objectives.
  
2. Attends variety of meetings, conferences, seminars as required or directed.

a41c666bcdb4e61112a6.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Remote Hygiene Recall Coordinator is the friendly, remote voice of Compassionate Dental Care, responsible for keeping the hygiene schedule full, keeping patients current on their preventive care, and reconnecting with patients who have fallen out of care to support the practice's growth.

**PAY**

$6-8/hour USD

9,000–12,000/hour ARS

**ABOUT COMPASSIONATE DENTAL CARE**

Compassionate Dental Care is a comprehensive family dental practice located in Lake in the Hills, Illinois, led by founder Dr. Timothy Stirneman, DDS, who has cared for local families for more than 30 years. The practice offers a full range of services under one roof, including preventive cleanings and exams, restorative and cosmetic dentistry, dental implants, periodontics, endodontics, orthodontics and Invisalign, same-day CEREC crowns, sedation, emergency care, and sleep apnea treatment. Compassionate Dental Care is built on comfort, trust, and compassion, taking the time to listen, explain every option clearly, and provide an atmosphere of continuous learning and mutual support where the team bands together to deliver the utmost care to every patient.

**SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* The schedule fill rate is consistently 90% or greater, with cancellations and no-shows held to 8% or less and last-minute openings filled quickly from the waitlist.
* Recall compliance is 85% or greater, out-of-care patients are rebooked at or above the monthly goal, and 90% or more of appointments are confirmed 24 to 48 hours in advance.
* Every call outcome and referral source is documented with 100% accuracy, and patient satisfaction with the scheduling experience is 95% or greater.

**OBJECTIVES**

* Answer inbound calls and make outbound calls to schedule new patient appointments, routine cleanings, and recommended treatment.
* Manage the recall and continuing care system, proactively contacting patients who are due or overdue for hygiene and periodontal visits.
* Re-engage patients who have fallen out of care through calls, texts, and emails, using approved scripts and a warm, caring tone.
* Confirm upcoming appointments 24 to 48 hours in advance and manage cancellations and reschedules according to office policy to minimize schedule gaps.
* Maintain an efficiently filled schedule by managing a waitlist and filling last-minute openings.
* Coordinate with the clinical and front office teams to ensure the schedule reflects proper appointment lengths and provider availability.
* Communicate clearly and compassionately with patients about appointment details, arrival instructions, and office policies.
* Accurately document call outcomes, referral sources, and patient notes in Open Dental.
* Track and report weekly on recall compliance, schedule fill rate, re-engagement results, and call activity.
* Participate in daily huddles, weekly virtual meetings, and ongoing training to stay aligned with practice goals and core values.
* Support other front office priorities as needed when scheduled duties are complete, always putting patient care first.

**COMPETENCIES**

* Warm, patient-focused phone presence that makes every caller feel welcomed and cared for.
* Natural relationship builder who earns patient trust and encourages consistent preventive care.
* Excellent written and spoken English communicator.
* Highly organized, staying accurate and composed while managing a high volume of calls and scheduling details.
* Self-directed and dependable, working independently while staying proactive and communicative with a U.S.-based team.
* Results-driven, motivated by schedule, recall, and re-engagement goals.
* Detail-oriented, with a commitment to accurate documentation.
* Accountable, transparent, and team-oriented in a patient-centered environment.
* Compassionate and empathetic, embodying the comfort and trust at the heart of the practice.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* High school diploma or equivalent required, with additional coursework or certification in dental office administration or customer service considered a plus.
* 1+ years of experience in scheduling, recall, patient re-engagement, or customer service, with dental or medical office experience strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with dental practice management software such as Open Dental, cloud phone systems such as Aloware, and Gmail, with the ability to learn new systems quickly.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the professionalism to represent the practice and coordinate closely with the in-office team.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Fully remote role requiring a reliable, private, and quiet home office suitable for professional patient calls.
* Computer with high-speed internet of at least 25 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload, plus a USB headset with a noise-cancelling microphone.
* Availability to work scheduled hours that overlap with the practice's U.S. Central time business hours, with extended periods of sitting, computer use, and phone communication.

**COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY**

As an equal opportunity employer committed to meeting the needs of a multigenerational and multicultural workforce, Compassionate Dental Care recognizes that a diverse staff, reflective of our community, is an integral and welcome part of a successful and ethical business. We hire local talent at all levels regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, or disability, and actively foster inclusion in all forms both within our company and across interactions with clients, candidates, and partners.

*By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that our talent team and authorized representatives may contact you regarding your application, interview scheduling, and employment opportunities via phone call, text message (SMS), and email using the contact information you provide. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out of text communications at any time by replying STOP.*

Job Type: Part-time

Pay: $30.00 - $35.00 per hour

Experience:

* Open Dental: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: Remote

48670c40720c0756ebb3.title: Client Support Specialist
48670c40720c0756ebb3.description:
**Client Support Specialist**
=============================

**Full-Time | Customer Service | Spectrum Healthcare Group** 
 
**Position Type:** Full-Time 
 
**Pay:** Starting at $19.00 an hour Based on experience
=======================================================================================================================================================

**Position Overview**
---------------------

Spectrum Healthcare Group is seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused Client Support Specialist to provide exceptional service to patients and support daily customer service operations.

This blended role combines patient communication, appointment scheduling, insurance verification, eligibility screening, and administrative support. The Client Support Specialist responds to patient inquiries by phone, chat, and email, verifies insurance benefits, assists with financial and coverage questions, and helps eligible clients navigate the AHCCCS application process.

The ideal candidate is organized, professional, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and passionate about helping people access healthcare services.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Customer Service & Communication**

* Respond to incoming calls, chats, and emails in a timely, professional, and courteous manner.
* Provide accurate information to patients, staff, insurance companies, and outside agencies.
* Manage high call volumes while maintaining excellent customer service.
* Direct calls, take messages, and route inquiries to the appropriate departments.
* Explain Spectrum Healthcare Group policies and procedures, including confidentiality requirements.
* Communicate calmly, clearly, and respectfully with individuals from diverse backgrounds.
* Follow established crisis response and telephone procedures when needed.

### **Appointment Scheduling & Administrative Support**

* Schedule, reschedule, and update patient appointments using established scheduling procedures.
* Perform accurate data entry and maintain complete, up-to-date patient records.
* Complete non-clinical intake paperwork and prepare reports as needed.
* Operate multi-line telephone systems, computers, electronic fax programs, email, and other office applications.
* Organize and prioritize tasks while maintaining accuracy and efficiency.
* Follow centralized scheduling policies and procedures.

### **Insurance Verification & Benefits Support**

* Verify patient insurance coverage for required services and procedures.
* Contact insurance companies to confirm eligibility, benefits, and coverage details.
* Enter and update patient insurance and benefit information accurately in the electronic medical record (EMR) system.
* Explain insurance coverage, applicable copayments, and available payment options to patients.
* Assist with payment receipt processes and financial information updates.
* Communicate professionally with insurance representatives, managed care organizations, and other relevant parties.
* Prepare eligibility reports and follow established verification procedures.

### **Eligibility Screening & Financial Assistance**

* Conduct client eligibility interviews and screenings.
* Complete AHCCCS applications and monitor application processing.
* Follow up on incomplete or unprocessed AHCCCS applications to help ensure timely resolution.
* Perform data entry related to client eligibility and financial updates.
* Make appropriate referrals to the Department of Economic Security (DES), Supplemental Security Income (SSI), and Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI).
* Help patients understand coverage requirements and available financial options.

### **Compliance & Professional Standards**

* Maintain compliance with agency policies, confidentiality requirements, and safety protocols.
* Follow applicable federal and state laws, accreditation requirements, and organizational compliance standards.
* Protect confidential patient information and follow established privacy procedures.
* Provide culturally responsive service that respects individual backgrounds and needs.
* Maintain professional, ethical, and collaborative relationships with patients, coworkers, insurance representatives, and community partners.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Required Education & Experience**
-----------------------------------

* High school diploma or GED required.
* Two years of experience working with clients in a medical and/or behavioral health setting preferred.
* Two years of data entry experience preferred.
* Two years of insurance experience, including work with contracted and managed care clients, preferred.
* Proficiency with multi-line telephone systems and standard office equipment required.
* Experience using electronic fax systems, email, and office applications required.
* Previous remote work experience preferred.
* Reliable high-speed internet service required.

**Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**
------------------------------------------

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

* Strong customer service and professional telephone etiquette.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Accurate and efficient typing, data entry, and document preparation skills.
* Basic math skills and the ability to operate a 10-key efficiently.
* Ability to manage high call volumes and multitask in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to prioritize tasks while maintaining accuracy and productivity.
* Knowledge of general medical terminology.
* Ability to communicate professionally with insurance companies and verify client eligibility accurately.
* Familiarity with insurance benefits, copayments, eligibility requirements, and payment processes.
* Ability to use scheduling systems to book, update, and reschedule appointments.
* Knowledge of standard office equipment, computers, electronic fax programs, and communication systems.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and follow established privacy policies.
* Knowledge of internal departments, customer service procedures, and organizational resources.
* Ability to respond calmly and appropriately to sensitive situations and follow established crisis telephone procedures.
* Flexibility, professionalism, sound judgment, and a commitment to providing quality service.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

A successful Client Support Specialist provides a positive patient experience while ensuring that appointments, insurance information, eligibility records, and administrative documentation are accurate and up to date. This role helps patients navigate coverage and financial questions while supporting efficient customer service operations across Spectrum Healthcare Group.

**Join Spectrum Healthcare Group**
----------------------------------

If you enjoy helping people, solving problems, staying organized, and supporting access to healthcare, we encourage you to apply for the Client Support Specialist position.

Join a team committed to professional service, patient support, and helping individuals connect with the care and resources they need.  
#Spectrum

**About beBright**

beBright is a doctor-founded, doctor-led organization dedicated to creating bright smiles and lifelong impact for children and families. Through exceptional providers, integrated pediatric dentistry and orthodontic care, and strong support systems, beBright delivers superior patient experiences and clinical outcomes. Focused exclusively on pediatric dentistry and orthodontics, beBright empowers local practices with clinical autonomy while providing comprehensive administrative and operational support. Since its founding, beBright has been a trusted partner to providers and practices and continues to grow with purpose. At beBright, every patient, provider, and team member’s smile is a priority.

**Position Summary**

The Patient Engagement Specialist is responsible for handling inbound and outbound patient communications across beBright's network of pediatric dental and orthodontic practices. This role focuses on new patient conversion, existing patient scheduling, recovery of unbooked and missed calls, and accurate documentation within our phone, practice management, and scheduling systems. Team members are expected to meet or exceed defined performance standards for answer rate, call quality, booking conversion, and follow-up completion. **This is a remote position with working hours of 8am-5pm CST Monday-Friday, with a one hour lunch break from 12pm-1pm each day.**

* Serve as the primary inbound point of contact for patients, answering calls promptly and professionally using approved scripting and brand-specific greetings.

* Escalate non-standard requests or issues to the appropriate practice team.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated ability to handle a high volume of inbound and outbound calls (80+ interactions per day) while maintaining quality.

* Comfortable working across multiple brands, time zones, and practice workflows.

* **Speed to Answer:** 10 second average
* **New Patient Booking Conversion:** Meet or exceed individual target based on role and brand mix
* **Call Quality Score:** Maintain 85%+ on quality reviews
* **Patient Engagement:** 100% of assigned outreach communications documented within defined SLA

**Work Environment & Physical Requirements**

* Primarily remote, seated role with extended periods of computer and headset use.
* Must adhere to beBright’s remote work policy.
* Must maintain a private, quiet, HIPAA-compliant workspace during all scheduled hours.

Services include inpatient and outpatient care, primary care, community health and wellness, workplace health, home health, community mental health, rehabilitation, long-term care and hospice.

  

BJC is the largest provider of charity care, unreimbursed care and community benefits in the state of Missouri. BJC and its hospitals and health service organizations provide $785.9 million annually in community benefit. That includes $410.6 million in charity care and other financial assistance to patients to ensure medical care regardless of their ability to pay. In addition, BJC provides additional community benefits through commitments to research, emergency preparedness, regional health care safety net services, health literacy, community outreach and community health programs and regional economic development.

  

BJC’s patients have access to the latest advances in medical science and technology through a formal affiliation between Barnes-Jewish Hospital and St. Louis Children’s Hospital with the renowned Washington University School of Medicine, which consistently ranks among the top medical schools in the country.

  

Expands BJC HealthCare's growth from hospitals located in the 500 mile catchment area, through direction of the BJC HealthCare corporate service line marketing initiatives. This includes the BJC Call Center, the WUSM Department of Pediatrics line, the SLCH Nurse Triage Answer Line, After Hours Service and Physician Exchange. Through telephone and internet vehicles, expands consumer and physician access to BJC¿s hospitals and corporate service lines. Includes 24/7 operation of multidisciplinary call centers that handle over 450,000 physician and consumer calls a year. Includes SLCH Children's Direct Physician Accessl Line/Transfer Center, which, in partnership with WUSM provides services including transfers, direct admits Transport Team dispatch, phone consults, referrals to/appointment for WUSM clinics, patient information, etc. generating incremental volume and margin to the system, enhanced communication with physicians and clients and high physician/patient satisfaction. Also delivers market research and customer relationship management activities.

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
  

**Role Purpose**

The Experience Center connects our consumers and patients to the care they need while increasing access to our health system and reducing friction. The Associate Advisor, Experience Center role is responsible for managing a high volume of inbound and outbound contacts for BJC Medical Group, Washington University, and private providers affiliated with BJC Health System. This position serves as the initial point of contact for patients seeking to establish care within our health system. This position also facilitates our patients' healthcare needs by fielding a variety of inquiries including event registration, patient navigation, and support for our MyChart patient portal.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Manage a high volume of customer contacts including: incoming and outbound calls , emails, chat, etc, from patients for a variety of reasons, to include tier one calls (single service line or domain)
* Manage inquiries/contacts within established performance and customer service standards; achieves targeted abandoned call rate, average speed of answer, average response time and average transaction time; provides excellent and consistent customer service for a variety of call types; communicates in a professional, positive and respectful manner with patients, providers, BJC staff and external organizations.

**BJC Total Rewards**

At BJC we’re committed to providing you and your family with benefits and resources to help you manage your physical, emotional, social and financial well-being.
