e34dd98a66d03f4db25b.title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
e34dd98a66d03f4db25b.description:
SHARP CLEANING SOLUTIONS Accounts Receivable & Administrative Coordinator

**Department:** Accounting & Operations  
**Reports To:** Owner / Operations Management  
**Work Arrangement:** Remote / Work From Home  
**Schedule:** Full-Time | 40 Hours Weekly | Established Office Hours

Job Overview

Sharp Cleaning Solutions is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and dependable **Accounts Receivable & Administrative Coordinator** to support our growing cleaning and property services company.

This position is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, managing invoicing and billing processes, assisting with payroll preparation, coordinating client communications, and supporting daily administrative operations.

Our company services multiple residential communities and commercial properties, requiring consistent communication with property managers, maintenance teams, field employees, and internal leadership.

The ideal candidate must be proactive, comfortable managing multiple accounts, and capable of working independently while maintaining a high level of accuracy and accountability.

**This is a fast-paced position that requires strong time management, responsiveness during office hours, and the ability to complete assignments accurately without constant oversight.**

Key Responsibilities

**1. Accounts Receivable & Billing Management**

* Prepare, review, and issue accurate client invoices based on completed services and approved pricing agreements.
* Verify service dates, property names, unit numbers, job descriptions, and pricing before processing invoices.
* Set up new client accounts using approved proposals, contracts, and billing instructions.
* Maintain accurate client pricing records and update account information when changes are approved.
* Monitor outstanding invoices, payment statuses, and account balances.
* Record and reconcile incoming payments, identifying missing, partial, or incorrectly applied payments.
* Research and resolve billing discrepancies in coordination with management.
* Prepare accounts receivable reports and communicate outstanding billing concerns.
* Coordinate with designated collection support personnel regarding overdue accounts and unresolved payments.

**2. Client Communication & Administrative Support**

* Monitor and respond to client emails, service requests, and administrative inquiries during established office hours.
* Maintain professional, timely communication with property managers, assistant managers, and maintenance supervisors.
* Respond to scheduling requests, invoice questions, billing concerns, and service-related administrative inquiries.
* Ensure client requests are properly documented and communicated to the appropriate team members.
* Follow up on outstanding requests to ensure timely resolution.
* Escalate urgent concerns, service issues, or requests requiring management approval.
* Maintain accurate records of client correspondence and outstanding action items.

**3. Scheduling & Service Verification**

* Assist with entering and updating service requests in the company's scheduling and operations platform.
* Verify property names, unit numbers, requested services, dates, and special instructions before scheduling.
* Coordinate with operations management regarding scheduling changes, cancellations, and additional services.
* Review completed job records to ensure services match scheduled assignments.
* Identify missing or incomplete service information before processing invoices.
* Communicate scheduling discrepancies promptly to management.
* Help ensure completed work is accurately documented for billing purposes.

**4. Team Member Follow-Up & Job Documentation**

* Communicate with field employees regarding missing service details, incomplete job reports, or required documentation.
* Verify that required before-and-after photos, service notes, and job completion records have been submitted.
* Follow up with team members on missing information necessary for accurate billing or payroll.
* Identify discrepancies between scheduled work and completed services.
* Escalate unresolved documentation issues to management.
* Maintain organized records to support accurate service verification and invoicing.

**5. Payroll Preparation & Verification**

* Assist with preparing and verifying employee payroll information for scheduled pay periods.
* Review submitted employee hours against schedules, completed assignments, and approved work records.
* Identify missing time entries, incorrect hours, duplicate entries, or other payroll discrepancies.
* Follow up with team members and management to obtain missing payroll information.
* Prepare payroll summaries and submit verified information for management approval.
* Assist with entering approved payroll information into the company's payroll platform, as authorized.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee compensation and payroll records.
* Ensure payroll-related assignments are completed by established deadlines.

**6. Client Vendor Portals & Invoice Submissions**

* Upload invoices and supporting documentation into designated client billing and vendor portals.
* Become proficient in navigating multiple property management and vendor payment systems.
* Verify invoice numbers, purchase orders, property information, service descriptions, and billing amounts before submission.
* Track invoice submission statuses, rejected invoices, and pending approvals.
* Correct portal submission errors promptly and follow up on unresolved issues.
* Maintain records confirming successful invoice uploads and submissions.
* Monitor portal requirements and communicate missing documentation or account access issues.
* Ensure invoices are submitted within each client's established billing deadlines.

**7. Reporting, Organization & Accountability**

* Maintain accurate daily records of completed tasks, outstanding assignments, and unresolved issues.
* Provide management with regular updates regarding invoicing, payment activity, payroll preparation, and administrative priorities.
* Organize client records, pricing agreements, invoices, and supporting documentation.
* Identify potential billing errors or process inefficiencies before they impact clients.
* Follow established company procedures and verification checklists.
* Complete assigned work within designated deadlines.
* Communicate proactively when clarification or additional support is needed.

Required Qualifications

* Previous experience in accounts receivable, bookkeeping, billing, or administrative accounting.
* Proficiency with QuickBooks or comparable accounting software.
* Strong Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and general computer skills.
* Experience navigating online billing portals or the ability to learn multiple systems quickly.
* Experience with payroll processing or payroll administration preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple client accounts and competing deadlines.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to recognize and correct discrepancies.
* Professional judgment when handling confidential financial and employee information.

Preferred Experience

* Experience supporting property management, multifamily housing, cleaning, maintenance, or other service-based businesses.
* Familiarity with property management vendor portals and invoice submission requirements.
* Experience with workforce scheduling, timekeeping, and field service management platforms.
* Experience reconciling service completion records against billing and payroll information.
* Experience communicating directly with property managers and operational teams.

Remote Work & Office Hour Expectations

This position requires consistent availability and active engagement throughout established working hours.

The selected candidate must:

* Maintain a reliable and distraction-managed remote workspace.
* Remain accessible through designated communication channels during scheduled hours.
* Monitor client communications and respond within company-established service standards.
* Prioritize time-sensitive billing, payroll, and scheduling requests.
* Maintain an accurate record of work performed and assignments completed.
* Participate in scheduled management meetings and performance reviews.
* Communicate availability changes, delays, or barriers to completing assigned responsibilities.

Performance Expectations

Success in this position will be evaluated based on:

* **Billing Accuracy:** Invoices and account setups are verified against approved pricing and service records.
* **Timely Invoicing:** Completed services are billed and submitted through required portals within established deadlines.
* **Client Responsiveness:** Emails and administrative requests receive timely, professional responses during office hours.
* **Payroll Accuracy:** Payroll information is reviewed, verified, and submitted according to established deadlines.
* **Documentation Compliance:** Missing photos, job notes, and service records are identified and followed up on promptly.
* **Task Completion:** Assigned responsibilities are completed accurately, consistently, and with minimal supervision.
* **Communication & Accountability:** Issues are identified early, escalated appropriately, and followed through to resolution.

Our Company Culture

At Sharp Cleaning Solutions, we believe operational excellence is just as important as the quality of services delivered in the field.

Our motto, **"We Don't Cut Corners, We Clean Them,"** applies to every aspect of our business, including accounting, scheduling, communication, payroll, and client relationships.

We value employees who demonstrate ownership, integrity, initiative, reliability, and a commitment to getting the details right.

**We're looking for someone who doesn't just complete tasks, but takes responsibility for making sure they're completed correctly.**

Job Type: Part-time

Pay: $18.00 - $20.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Opportunities for advancement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

914188dfbd953eff2f75.title: Customer Care Pharmacy Support Specialist
914188dfbd953eff2f75.description:
At our company, we move fast, adapt quickly, and turn challenges into opportunities—all while keeping quality at the heart of everything we do. We believe that work should be a positive and respectful place, and that with the right mindset, anything is achievable.  
**Our Vision:**  
Fulfill the essential promise of pharmacy care and help people to live to their healthiest, happiest, and fullest potential.  
**Our Mission:**  
To be the disruptive force that drives meaningful change within pharmacy services.

Shifts: Monday to Friday:

* 8am-430pm
* 9am-530pm
* 930am-6pm

**Summary**  
The Customer Care Pharmacy Support Specialist is a Customer Care position responsible for supporting partner clients, patients and providers with pharmacy and prescription claim inquiries. This role combines inbound contact center and expertise with pharmacy technician knowledge and the ability to research, troubleshoot, and reprocess pharmacy claims for authorized partner clients. The position serves as a subject matter expert and  
analytical resource within Customer Care while collaborating with the Pharmacy, Client Services, and Operations. Success in this role is demonstrated through accurate claim resolution, quality customer experiences, appropriate claim reprocessing, and adherence to client, regulatory, and organizational requirements. This position reports to the Manager or Supervisor, Customer Care.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Provide advanced support for complex patient, pharmacy, provider, and client inquiries across supported lines of business.
* Validate claim information, eligibility, benefit requirements, and other applicable information before initiating an authorized claim reprocessing transaction.
* Reprocess pharmacy claims for authorized partner clients in accordance with client-specific requirements, approved procedures, assigned system permissions, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and escalation resource for Customer Care
* Advocates regarding pharmacy benefits, claims, systems, and client-specific processes.
* Follow-up with patients as needed to ensure medication orders are processed.
* Support patients, providers and members with pharmacy mail order coordination.
* Handle sensitive and escalated customer interactions requiring advanced research, judgment, and problem-solving.
* Perform authorized pharmacy technician functions within applicable laws, regulations, organizational procedures, and the defined scope of the position.
* Ensure compliance with HIPAA, applicable pharmacy requirements, client requirements, and organizational policies.
* Perform additional duties as assigned.

**Education and Experience**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Active Pharmacy Technician registration, license or certification required.
* Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT) credential preferred.
* 1-2 years pharmacy/customer service experience preferred.
* Experience processing or reprocessing pharmacy benefit claims strongly preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Experience processing or reprocessing pharmacy benefit claims strongly preferred.
* Ability to reprocess pharmacy claims accurately within assigned system
* permissions and established procedures.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to distinguish issues that can be resolved operationally from those requiring
* pharmacist, clinical, configuration, compliance, or leadership intervention.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced Customer Care
* environment.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with integrity.

**Work Environment / Physical Demands**  
This position is in a typical office environment which requires prolonged sitting in front of a computer. Requires hand-eye coordination and manual dexterity sufficient to operate standard office equipment including operation of standard computer and phone equipment. May have occasional high stress when dealing with customers/clients. Some travel may be required.  
EOE M/F/D/V – WellDyne and HealthDyne are equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination of any kind. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local law.

88407df2ba4c1217251e.description:
* Models and delivers a distinctive and delightful customer experience.
* Registers sales on assigned cash register, provides customers with courteous, fair, friendly, and efficient checkout service.
* In accordance with state and federal regulations, assists the pharmacist, under direct supervision, in the practice of pharmacy. Responsible for using pharmacy systems to obtain patient and drug information and process prescriptions.

**Customer Experience**

* Engages customers and patients by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. Resolves customer issues and answers questions to ensure a positive customer experience.
* Models and shares customer service best practices with all team members to deliver a distinctive and delightful customer experience, including interpersonal habits (e.g., greeting, eye contact, courtesy, etc.) and Walgreens service traits (e.g., offering help proactively, identifying needs, servicing until satisfied, etc.).

**Operations**

* Provides customers with courteous, friendly, fast, and efficient service.
* Recommends items for sale to customer and recommends trade-up and/or companion items.
* Registers customer purchases on assigned cash register, collects cash and distributes change as requested; processes voids, returns, rain checks, refunds, and exchanges as needed. Takes customer to OTC aisle when possible to assist in locating products.
* Keeps counters and shelves clean and well merchandised, takes inventory, and maintains records. Checks in and prices merchandise as required or as directed by store manager or communicated by the shift leader.
* Performs duties as assigned by Pharmacy Manager, Staff Pharmacist and Store Manager including utilizing pharmacy systems to enter patient and drug information, ensuring information is entered correctly, filling prescriptions by retrieving, counting and pouring pharmaceutical drugs, verifying medicine is correct, and checking for possible interactions. Assists pharmacists in scheduling and maintaining work flow.
* Reports, immediately, prescription errors to pharmacist on duty and adheres to Company policies and procedures in relation to pharmacy errors and the Quality Improvement Program. Reviews and complies with the Walgreen Co. Pharmacy Code of Conduct.
* Strictly adheres to the Walgreen Co. policy regarding Good Faith Dispensing during all applicable prescription dispensing activities.

* Processes (corrects and resubmits) manual claims for third party program prescription services in a timely and efficient manner, and performs other clerical duties, as assigned by the Pharmacy Manager.
* Assists and supports Pharmacy Department on inventory management activities, such as, ordering, unpacking, checking and storing shipment of pharmaceuticals. Maintains knowledge of Company asset protection techniques, and files claims for warehouse overages (merchandise received, but not billed), shortages (merchandise billed, but not received), order errors or damaged goods involving Rx drugs.

* Constructs and maintains displays, including promotional, seasonal, super structures, and sale merchandise. Completes resets and revisions as directed.
* Assists with separation of food items (e.g., raw foods from pre-cooked) and product placement as specified by policies/procedures (e.g., raw and frozen meats on bottom shelves). For consumable items, assists in stock rotation, using the first in, first out method and restock outs.
* Has working knowledge of store systems and store equipment.
* Provides customer service in the photo area, including digital passport photo service, poster print and creative machine, suggestive sell of promotional photo products.
* Assumes web pick-up responsibilities (monitors orders in Picture Care Plus, fills orders (pick items), delivers orders to customers as they arrive at store).
* Assists with exterior and interior maintenance by ensuring clean, neat, orderly store condition and appearance.
* Complies with all company policies and procedures; maintains respectful relationships with coworkers.

* Earns and maintains PTCB certification through the designated PTCB training program and/or state required certification/registration.
* Attends training and completes PPLs requested by Manager or assigned by corporate and acquires continuing education credits. Maintains knowledge and skill in healthcare and pharmacy, including latest news and developments.

* Must be fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English. (Except in Puerto Rico)

**Preferred Qualifications**
  

* Prefer six months of experience in a retail environment.
* Prefer to have prior work experience with Walgreens.
* Prefer good math skills so they can fill prescriptions accurately, including counting, measuring and weighing medications.
* Prefer good computer skills.
* Prefer the knowledge of store inventory control.

0ad50fdd5e279ac723fe.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
0ad50fdd5e279ac723fe.description:
**Are you ready to embark on a career that truly affects people around the world? Trulioo invites you to be a catalyst for change in the dynamic realm of digital identity verification. As the global front-runner in our industry, we are redefining how businesses grow, innovate and comply online.**

Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.

But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a **BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year**, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.

Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.

**What We Offer**

* **Comprehensive Benefits:** We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.
* **Flexible Hybrid Working Environment:** Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.
* **Wellness:** We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.
* **Employee Resource Groups:** Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.

**Position Summary:**
---------------------

Reporting to the Director, Customer Success, the Strategic Customer Success Manager plays a pivotal role in maintaining and growing customer health and revenue by aligning customer needs, product capabilities, and evolving use cases. This position combines entrepreneurial drive, deep technical aptitude, and collaborative leadership with the ability to influence senior leaders and work across high-profile customers in Payments, Marketplaces, Online Trading, Crypto, Banking, and Wealth Management. As a strategic member of the team, you partner with peers and senior executives across Trulioo and customer organizations to drive customer outcomes, expand adoption, increase revenue, and shape the company's direction. You also support complex cross-functional projects that have significant impact on Trulioo's growth and long-term success.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This is a full-time, permanent position, working remotely from anywhere in the United States, with a preference for candidates based in San Diego, San Francisco, or New York.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Proven track record managing multi-million-dollar enterprise customers, driving adoption, retention, and revenue growth, with demonstrated success in complex SaaS expansion and executive-level relationships.

* Experience with the following tools/technology: Excel or BI tools.
* Working fluency using AI in your own account management workflow, with a repeatable process and a habit of verifying output before relying on it, plus experience introducing a shared workflow or template that other team members use, and sound judgment on where AI should not touch confidential customer data.

**Interview Process:**

Owns the inventory, organization, and operational readiness of the photo department by maintaining supplies, monitoring inventory levels, and ensuring product and service availability to meet customer needs. Promotes photo products and services, assists customers at checkout registers, accurately processes transactions and cash handling activities, supports merchandising initiatives, and collaborates with team members to maintain a clean, safe, and customer focused environment while achieving operational and business goals.

Training & Personal Development

corporate.

faabc5345f57bf443ca1.title: Regional Sales Director - South/Southeast
faabc5345f57bf443ca1.description:
**Role overview**
-----------------

**Reports to:** Managing Director

**Location:** Southeast — Hybrid / Remote, U.S.

**Employment Type:** Full-time, Exempt

**Team:** Leads 8-10 Territory Managers across the assigned U.S. region

**Compensation:** Base salary (commensurate with experience) plus a 12% override on the region's team sales performance and an annual bonus targeted at 10% of base salary, tied to team goal attainment

TinyMobileRobots® is seeking a Regional Sales Director to lead, coach, and develop a team of 8–10 Territory Managers who sell and lease the company's autonomous line-marking robots to sports field customers across an assigned U.S. region. This role owns the team's performance against revenue, unit, and demo targets, and builds a disciplined, accountable sales culture through coaching, structured performance management, and consistent field presence. The Regional Sales Director is a key member of the U.S. leadership team and represents TinyMobileRobots as a recognized expert in the field maintenance and sports turf industry.

**Team leadership, coaching & accountability**
----------------------------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 8-10 Territory Managers, building a high-performing, accountable sales team
* Maintain full staffing levels. Source, interview, and onboard new Territory Managers as needed
* Teach, train, and reinforce the team's Sales Method of Operation (SMO), including effective time and territory management
* Run the team's operating rhythm: weekly team meetings, three quarterly business reviews (QBRs), and one annual team meeting
* Conduct in-field work-withs (targeting 24 live and 56 virtual annually) and joint sales calls with Territory Managers to reinforce selling skills and territory execution
* Own ongoing performance management: set key performance indicators (KPIs), conduct performance reviews, and manage performance improvement plans (PIPs) as needed
* Hold individual Territory Managers accountable to their goals through direct, consistent feedback
* Motivate and inspire the team to drive engagement, retention, and sustained performance
* Build and maintain a formal sales skills training playbook for the team

**Driving results, field presence & cross-functional leadership**
-----------------------------------------------------------------

* Drive the team to its annual targets: Revenue, units sold, demonstrations
* Own full-line selling performance across the region: average sale, average invoice total, customers installed, and accessories
* Ensure customer issues are properly logged and resolved, and manage the balance of Territory Managers' time between new business and customer support
* Facilitate the development of consistent Lead Generation by and for each Territory Manager and the total team
* Attend regional and national trade shows and industry events, representing TinyMobileRobots
* Build and expand a network of relationships across Parks & Recreation departments, colleges/universities, high schools & school districts, and professional/amateur sports organizations
* Become a recognized expert in the field maintenance and sports turf industry, and in the use of autonomous marking technology
* Identify and support market expansion opportunities, including geographic growth and new customer segments
* Expand national partnerships and key accounts within the region
* Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Customer/Service, and Product teams to align regional execution with company strategy
* Serve as an active, visible member of the U.S. leadership team, contributing to company-wide sales strategy and decisions

**Qualifications & experience**
-------------------------------

**Required**

* 5+ years of progressive B2B field sales experience, including selling a technical or capital equipment product
* 3+ years of experience leading, coaching, and managing a sales team, ideally a distributed or remote field team
* Proven track record building accountable, high-performing sales teams and managing them to quota
* Strong coaching skills; comfortable running structured field work-withs and joint sales calls
* Skilled communicator, comfortable with verbal, written, and public speaking or group facilitation
* Sound business and financial judgment
* Proficient with customer relationship management (CRM) systems (Hubspot preferred), Microsoft Office/Google Workspace, and virtual meeting platforms
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* Willing and able to travel extensively throughout the assigned region

**Preferred**

* Experience in the turf, green industry, sports field, or capital/outdoor equipment markets
* Experience managing a fully remote or geographically dispersed team
* Advanced degree, certificates, professional education/training
* Familiarity with structured sales methodologies (e.g., Challenger, MEDDPICC, or similar)

**Requirements & equal opportunity**
------------------------------------

**Physical requirements**

* Drive extensively throughout the assigned region, including overnight travel
* Lift and transport equipment up to 80 lbs, such as demonstration robots and supplies, in and out of a vehicle
* Operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and mobile devices for extended periods
* Work outdoors in varied conditions (heat, cold, rain, and uneven or sloped terrain) during field work-withs and demonstrations

**Other requirements**

* Valid driver's license. Must pass a motor vehicle driving report, background check, and substance abuse test
* Fluency in English, bi-lingual preferred
* Own or lease a personal vehicle with hauling space for a robot and supplies, as needed for field work-withs

TinyMobileRobots is an equal opportunity employer and doesn't discriminate in hiring or employment, in accordance with all applicable U.S. laws, including race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, gender, marital status, military status, sexual orientation, disability, or medical condition.

Aviation Operations Advisor - LATAM - 18975

**Description**
---------------

**About Us:**

AAR’s purpose is to empower people to build innovative aerospace solutions today so you can safely reach your destination tomorrow. The company’s mission is to go above and beyond to provide value-driven aerospace aftermarket solutions to meet the evolving needs of our customers worldwide. AAR constantly searches for the right thing to do for its customers, employees, partners and for society.

The Worldwide Aviation Support Services (WASS) program, an AAR business, headquartered in Rockledge, FL, provides global, world-class expeditionary and conventional aviation solutions to the US Department of State Air Wing.

**Role Description:**

The Aviation Operations Advisor is the senior aviation subject matter expert and principal advisor to Host Nation aviation organizations. The Advisor provides operational guidance, mentoring, technical assistance, and capacity-building support to aviation units within the National Police, Frontier and Border Police, and other authorized Host Nation government organizations. These organizations support law enforcement, border security, counternarcotics, and public safety missions. The Aviation Operations Advisor collaborates with the U.S. Embassy representatives, Host Nation leadership, WASS Program Management Office Leadership, and other stakeholders to improve aviation operational effectiveness, safety, mission planning, standardization, training, and integration of Manned and Unmanned aircraft systems. The Advisor assists in developing aviation policies, procedures, training programs, and operational concepts that enhance Host Nation aviation capabilities while ensuring compliance with applicable international, U.S. Government, and Host Nation standards.

**Key R****esponsibility:**

* Serve as the principal aviation operations advisor to designated Host Nation aviation organizations.
* Advise Host Nation leadership on aviation operations, safety programs, aircrew training, mission planning, risk management, and operational readiness.
* Provide subject matter expertise in both manned and unmanned aircraft operations supporting law enforcement, border security, surveillance, reconnaissance, aerial interdiction, disaster response, and public safety missions.
* Assist Host Nation aviation leadership in developing operational policies, procedures, training programs, and standard operating procedures.
* Provide senior-level operational recommendations while respecting Host Nation command authority, established command relationships, and defined advisory responsibilities.
* Advise on aviation organizational structures, command and control relationships, operational planning processes, and resource utilization.
* Conduct operational assessments of aviation capabilities, aircraft utilization, mission performance, and operational effectiveness, and recommend improvements to safety, efficiency, mission capability, and aviation readiness.
* Support development of aviation training plans for pilots, aircrew members, mission operators, and unmanned aircraft operators.
* Advise on aircrew standardization, flight evaluations, instructor development, proficiency programs, and compliance with approved operational procedures.
* Assist Host Nation personnel with mission planning, operational coordination, and air mission scheduling, and advise on mission risk assessment, threat mitigation, operational decision-making, and aviation risk management processes appropriate to the operating environment.
* Advise on integration of intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance, ISR, capabilities into mission planning, operational coordination, and post-mission assessments, consistent with applicable authorities.
* Promote structured after-action reviews and lessons-learned processes to improve aviation procedures, operational effectiveness, and program performance.
* Assess Host Nation aviation capabilities and recommend measurable capacity-building plans, training priorities, equipment requirements, and milestones toward sustainable independent operations.
* Coordinate with maintenance, logistics, training, and operations personnel to improve overall aviation program effectiveness.
* Provide guidance regarding integration of unmanned aircraft systems into existing aviation operations.
* Support development of aviation safety management programs and aviation accident prevention initiatives.
* Develop and monitor aviation key performance indicators, KPIs, operational readiness measures, and return-on-investment, ROI, reporting to assess mission effectiveness, resource utilization, and program outcomes.
* Evaluate fleet utilization, aircrew staffing, operational tempo, mission scheduling, and resource allocation to improve aircraft availability, mission effectiveness, and cost efficiency.
* Prepare briefings, reports, assessments, and recommendations for Host Nation leadership, U.S. Embassy representatives, and WASS program management personnel.
* Maintain liaison with U.S. Government representatives, Host Nation officials, and aviation stakeholders as required to support mission objectives.
* Facilitate interagency coordination among Host Nation aviation organizations, U.S. Embassy personnel, INLACBA representatives, and other authorized law enforcement and aviation stakeholders.
* Assist in evaluating future aviation capability requirements and strategic planning initiatives.
* Ensure all advisory activities are conducted in accordance with applicable contract requirements, U.S. Government guidance, and Host Nation regulations.
* Support inspections, assessments, audits, and aviation program reviews as directed.
* Travel throughout the assigned country and region in support of program objectives.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Aviation Management, Aviation Operations, Aeronautical Science, Business Management, Public Administration, or related field or equivalent military or professional experience.
* Minimum of 12 years of progressively responsible aviation experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in aviation management, aviation operations leadership, aviation training, or aviation advisory roles.
* Rated pilot with FAA Commercial, ATP, Military Aviator equivalent, or Rotary Wing Airman certification.
* Minimum 1,500 hours total flight time.
* Minimum 1,000 hours Pilot-in-Command time.
* Experience conducting aviation operations in austere, expeditionary, remote, or hazardous operating environments, both CONUS and OCONUS.
* Demonstrated experience planning, managing, or supervising fixed-wing, rotary-wing, or mixed-fleet aviation operations.
* Demonstrated understanding of unmanned aircraft systems operations and integration into public safety, security, law enforcement, or military missions.
* Strong English speaking and written communication skills.
* Spanish language proficiency L-3-R-3 preferred; L-2-R-2 minimum required, as assessed under the applicable contract or program standard.
* Experience developing aviation policies, operational procedures, or training programs.
* Strong briefing, presentation, mentorship, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with senior government officials and multinational stakeholders.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of State Moderate Risk Public Trust, MRPT, security clearance.

Preferred

* Previous experience advising foreign government, military, police, or public safety aviation organizations.
* Experience supporting U.S. Department of State, INLA, Department of Defense, DHS, CBP, DEA, or similar aviation programs.
* Experience with ISR, border security, counternarcotics, or law enforcement aviation operations.
* Experience operating with Night Vision Goggles.
* Experience supporting UAS programs employed for surveillance, reconnaissance, or public safety operations.
* Experience developing aviation standardization, instructor pilot, or flight evaluation programs.
* Experience managing operational readiness assessments, aviation performance metrics, and government program reporting.
* Experience coordinating multi-aircraft or mixed-fleet operations in international or expeditionary environments.
* Previous experience in Latin America.

We are excited to announce we are looking for a Bilingual Virtual Patient Navigator to support our Patient Support Program as a resource for patients living with acromegaly. Our Bilingual Virtual Patient Navigator will provide education about specific disease treatments and resources to empower patients to understand and manage their disease state. This role will be responsible for one on one communications with patients as well as medical professionals associated with the treatment process.

  
  

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Answers calls in a professional and timely manner.
* Document review of prescriptions, case notes and appointment results.
* Adverse Event review and reporting as necessary.
* Initiate case creation in CRM.
* Participate in scheduling process from start to finish by scheduling and confirming appointments with patients and network clinicians.
* Assist in determining that each appointment is staffed with a properly credentialed clinician for the appointment location.
* Document case details in Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system.
* Place outbound calls and text messages to patients and network clinicians.
* Answer incoming calls, text messages, and email correspondence.
* Provide program coverage as needed when team members are out of office.
* Escalate issues to leadership and work on Program improvements.
* Assist patients in finding resources for their disease state in their area
* Educating patients on disease state.
* Coordinate and facilitate the connection between patients and program approved, patient-based resources.
* Provide direct educational training to patients and assigned medication.
* Provide patient-focused education to promote behavioral change for the empowerment of patients to improve specific treatment compliance.
* Foster appropriate dialogue between patient and health care provider.
* Travel up to 15%.
  

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Active Nursing License in good standing.
* Bilingual in English/Spanish.
* 2+ years of recent nursing experience that includes, but not limited to direct patient care, physical assessment, patient education, group in -servicing and proficiency in peripheral access.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office, especially MS Teams, Excel, Word, and Outlook.
* Proven success utilizing good communication, speaking, and writing skills when interacting with customers.
* Ability to interact courteously and professionally with patients and clinical staff.
* Must reside in country where the job is posted.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Nurse educator experience.
* Experience with Salesforce, the Customer Relationship Management System.
* Excellent time management skills and ability to multi-task and prioritize work.
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and as a team player.
* Knowledge of clinical data and pharmacology.
* Demonstrated time management skills; planning and prioritization skills; ability to multi-task and maintain prioritization of key projects and deadlines.
  

  

#LI-Remote

  
  

Note: This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have authorization to work in the US without the need for sponsorship.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

IQVIA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable law. https://jobs.iqvia.com/eoe

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

The potential base pay range for this role is $80-95k annually. The actual base pay offered may vary based on a number of factors including job-related qualifications such as knowledge, skills, education, and experience; location; and/or schedule (full or part-time). Dependent on the position offered, incentive plans, bonuses, and/or other forms of compensation may be offered, in addition to a range of health and welfare and/or other benefits.

**Where you'll work**
---------------------

### **Home-based**

You’ll work remotely, with the flexibility to do your best work from home. Supported by collaborative tools and a global team, you’ll stay connected while enjoying the autonomy and balance that comes with a fully remote role.

  

**Culture**
-----------

Culture at IQVIA is built on a shared belief: that when people are empowered with better data, smarter technology and deeper expertise, they can change what’s possible for patients. Across every team and every corner of the globe, you’ll find colleagues who genuinely care — about the mission and about each other. That’s what makes this a place where people tend to stay, grow and do the best work of their careers.

* Registers sales on assigned cash register, provides customers with courteous, fair, friendly, and efficient checkout service.

20947a4ec527a67e9073.title: Inventory Specialist
20947a4ec527a67e9073.description:
* Responsible for executing, monitoring, and training inventory best practices and standard operating procedures for the entire store, including both front end and pharmacy. Supports pharmacy inventory management activities, including receiving, counting, ordering, and facilitating returns. Champions On-Shelf Availability and is responsible for receiving, counting, pricing, returns, and all in-store inventory processes. Validates and ensures accuracy of planograms.
* Responsible for reviewing and coordinating the proper use of reports and system applications, which have an impact on the accuracy of front end and pharmacy on-hand balances and pricing.
* Responsible for executing and maintaining front end and pharmacy asset protection techniques, and filing claims for warehouse and vendor overages (merchandise received, but not billed), shortages (merchandise billed, but not received), order errors or damaged goods including prescription drugs.
* In designated stores, as required, opens and closes the store in the absence of store management, including all required systems start-ups, required cash handling and cashier responsibilities, and ensuring the floor and stock room are ready for the business day.

**Customer Experience**

* Engages customers by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. In designated stores, when serving as the leader on duty, resolves customer issues and answers questions to ensure a positive customer experience.
* Models and shares customer service best practices with all team members to deliver a distinctive and delightful customer experience, including interpersonal habits (e.g., greeting, eye contact, courtesy, etc.) and Walgreens service traits (e.g., offering help proactively, identifying needs, servicing until satisfied, etc.).

**Operations**

* Executes and coaches team members on warehouse and vendor inventory management processes including but not limited to creating, reviewing, and receiving orders.
* Scans in all deliveries while the vendor is still in the store, including common carrier deliveries. Focuses on One Box receiving. Takes the appropriate action marking delivery as received if the product was physically delivered, contacting vendor for past undelivered scheduled receipts, and opening tickets as needed to correct inaccurate orders.
* Under the supervision of the pharmacist-in-charge, verifies all pharmacy shipments are posted for products physically received at the store. Completes or verifies postings of all pharmacy warehouse orders, ABC prescription and OTC orders daily, secondary vendor orders, flu and dropship orders performing any necessary tote audits, and accurately reporting any shortages or damaged product.
* Completes On-Shelf Availability (OSA) end-to-end process including warehouse and direct store delivery (DSD) for planogrammed departments, executing disposals, call-ins, and vendor returns before expiration, completes scan outs/ scan outs returns on all subscribed departments including vendor/ DSD departments and pharmacy scan outs.
* Under the supervision of the pharmacist-in-charge,completes pharmacy inventory activities including but not limited to pharmacy recalls following Pharmacy Hazardous Waste Policy, vendor returns, non-controlled, and damaged salvage returns. Facilitates excess inventory returns or interstore pharmacy transfers where applicable for non-returnable ABC overstock. Verifies posting of all pharmacy/ prescription claims.
* Completes execution of all pricing activities including price changes, markdowns, and markdowns deletes. Responsible for basic department pricing, including daily price changes, accurate pricing with correct signage, and reliable and timely completion of any additional regulatory pricing tasks.
* Responsible for supporting front end and pharmacy ordering by ordering expense items. Monitors pharmacy manual orders to identify excess orders. Maintains consigned inventory and orders as required.
* Ensures all designated pull & quarantine item on-hands are updated and placed in the designated holding area.
* Maintains accurate inventory counts. Maintains the accuracy of on-hand quantities including but not limited to basic departments, stockroom, overstock locations.
* Under the supervision of the pharmacist-in-charge, maintains accurate inventory counts and accuracy of on-hand quantities in pharmacy and completes pharmacy smart counts.
* Ensures the store maintains inventory compliance with state and local laws regarding regulated products (e.g., alcoholic beverages and tobacco products).
* Assists in the maintenance of inventory records, including receiving and posting of all products (in the front-end)) received at the store in all inventory systems. Organizes files and retains all invoices/receipts/return authorizations necessary for all inventory activities.
* Helps to prepare for physical inventory and supports the physical inventory day activities, including but not limited to preparing sales floor, stockroom, and pharmacy for inventory and auditing the third party team on the day of inventory.
* Supports keeping all counters and shelves clean and well merchandised.
* Knowledgeable of all store systems and equipment.
* Assists and coaches store team on all package delivery activities, including scanning in and out of packages, completing all daily inventory functions and, package returns at Walgreens. Supports execution of Pickup Program.
* In designated stores, when serving as the leader on duty, responsible and accountable for registering all related sales on assigned point-of-sale system (POS), including records of scanning errors, price verifications, items not on file, price modifications, and voids. Completes product returns, order voids, customer refunds, cash drops to safe, and provides change as requested for point of sale.
* Complies with all company policies and procedures; maintains respectful relationships with coworkers.
* Completes any additional activities and other tasks as assigned.

**Training & Personal Development**

* Attends company-based trainings for continuous development and completes all e-learning modules including safety training requirements.
* Obtains and maintains a valid pharmacy license/certification as required by the state.

**Communications**

* Serves as a liaison between management and non-management team members by coaching and developing other capabilities with inventory systems. When serving as the leader on duty, communicates assigned tasks to team members and reports disciplinary issues and customer complaints to management.
  

  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
  

* Six months of prior work experience with Walgreens (internal candidates) or one year of prior retail work experience (external candidates).
* Must be fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English (except in Puerto Rico).
* Must have a willingness to work a flexible schedule, including evening and weekend hours.
* Demonstrated attention to detail and ability to multi task and manage execution.
* Experience in identifying operational issues and recommending and implementing strategies to resolve problems.
  

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
  

* Prefer previous experience as a shift lead, pharmacy technician, designated hitter, or customer service associate.
* Prefer to have prior work experience with Walgreens, with an evaluation on file.

We will consider employment of qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

01b7b01a4f0fc5638623.title: Pharmacy Technician / Pharm Tech Apprenticeship
01b7b01a4f0fc5638623.description:
Our pharmacy technician positions have undergone an exciting transformation, moving from a transaction-based environment to a much more patient-centric one. As a Walgreens Pharmacy Technician or Pharmacy Technician Apprentice, you'll be front and center – interacting with our customers and developing strong patient relationships. Pharmacy is the core of our business, and our pharmacy technicians enjoy all the tools and support – including the latest technology – to grow their careers and reach their goals.
  
  
Walgreens is proud to invest & champion an “earn while you learn” Pharmacy Technician Training Program recognized by ASHP & Department of Labor. This apprenticeship program gives you an entry point to a career in health care by guiding you in taking steps towards becoming a Pharmacy Technician Certification Board (PTCB) Certified Pharmacy Technician and helping you maintain the high level of skill required in the pharmacy care industry. Arming you with a nationally recognized, portable credential that will help you advance your career.
  
  
Whether you are new to working in pharmacies or are an experienced Pharmacy Technician Apply Now! Walgreens will train you to use your skills and talents to serve and care for our patients and customers. The courses, learning activities, and resources provided to you in our pharmacy technician training program are designed to give you foundational and advanced knowledge, skills, and on-the-job experiences you need to prepare to become a certified pharmacy technician.
  

* In accordance with state and federal regulations, assists the pharmacist, under direct supervision, in the practice of pharmacy. Assists the pharmacist in the performance of other Pharmacy Department duties in accordance with Company policies and procedures.
* Responsible for using pharmacy systems to obtain patient and drug information and process prescriptions. If PTCB certified, assists with and coaches pharmacy technicians in the operation of pharmacy systems and cashiers in the operation of the pharmacy cash registers.
* Models and delivers a distinctive and delightful customer experience.

**Customer Experience**

* Engages customers and patients by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. Resolves customer issues and answers questions to ensure a positive customer experience.
* Models and shares customer service best practices with all team members to deliver a distinctive and delightful customer experience, including interpersonal habits (e.g., greeting, eye contact, courtesy, etc.) and Walgreens service traits (e.g., offering help proactively, identifying needs, servicing until satisfied, etc.).
* Develops strong relationships with most valuable customers.

  
**Operations**

* Under the supervision by the pharmacist, assist in the practice of pharmacy, in accordance with state, federal, and company policy. Reviews and complies with the Walgreen Co. Pharmacy Code of Conduct.
* Performs duties as assigned by Pharmacy Manager, Staff Pharmacist and Store Manager including utilizing pharmacy systems to enter patient and drug information, ensuring information is entered correctly, filling prescriptions by retrieving, counting and pouring pharmaceutical drugs, verifying medicine is correct, and checking for possible interactions. Assists pharmacists in scheduling and maintaining work flow.
* Reports, immediately, prescription errors to pharmacist on duty and adheres to Company policies and procedures in relation to pharmacy errors and the Quality Improvement Program.
* Strictly adheres to the Walgreen Co. policy regarding Good Faith Dispensing during all applicable prescription dispensing activities.
* Responsible and accountable for registering all related sales on assigned cash register, collects and handles cash as required. Takes customer to OTC aisle when possible, to assist in locating products.
* Handles telephone calls that do not require personal attention of the pharmacist, including those to physicians.
* Processes (corrects and resubmits) manual claims for third party program prescription services in a timely and efficient manner, and performs other clerical duties, as assigned by the Pharmacy Manager.
* Assists and supports Pharmacy Department on inventory management activities, such as, ordering, unpacking, checking and storing shipment of pharmaceuticals. Maintains knowledge of Company asset protection techniques, and files claims for warehouse overages (merchandise received, but not billed), shortages (merchandise billed, but not received), order errors or damaged goods involving Rx drugs.
* May assist pharmacist in administering clinical services including the collection and proper labeling of blood/urine samples from patients and other clinical services as required; assists pharmacy staff in coordination of clinical services, Walgreens healthcare clinics and external providers.
* Assists Pharmacy Manager and Staff Pharmacist in developing and maintaining good relationships with the local medical community, including physicians, nurses, and other health care providers, by medical provider detailing and outreach to health groups, retirement homes, nursing homes, and other forums for enhancing growth opportunities.
* Assists with exterior and interior maintenance by ensuring the Pharmacy Department is stocked with adequate supplies, clean, neat and orderly in condition and appearance.
* Complies with all company policies and procedures; maintains respectful relationships with coworkers.
* Completes special assignments and other tasks as assigned.

  
**Training & Personal Development**

* Earns and maintains PTCB certification through the designated PTCB training program and/or state required certification/registration. Otherwise, earns PTCB certification as condition of promotion to senior technician.
* Attends training requested by Manager and acquires continuing education credits. Maintains knowledge and skill in healthcare and pharmacy, including latest news and developments.
  

  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
  

* Must be fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English. (Except in Puerto Rico)
* Requires willingness to work flexible schedule, including evening and weekend hours.
  

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
  

* Prefer six months of experience in a retail environment.
* Prefer to have prior work experience with Walgreens.
* Prefer good math skills so they can fill prescriptions accurately, including counting, measuring and weighing medications.
* Prefer good computer skills.
* Prefer the knowledge of store inventory control.
* Prefer PTCB certification.

e66fecb1a74c2c367b30.title: Bilingual Outbound Caller — Marketing
e66fecb1a74c2c367b30.description:
About the Role The PFirm, LLC is hiring a Bilingual Outbound Caller to support our marketing and outreach efforts. This is a work-from-home position focused on proactive outbound calling — contacting prospective patients, referral sources, and past contacts, explaining our services clearly, and helping interested callers take the next step. This is not an inbound reception role. We are looking for someone who is confident on the phone, comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls, and able to build rapport quickly in both English and Spanish. Bilingual is a must. You must be fully fluent in English and Spanish — speaking, understanding, and writing — to be considered for this position. Key Responsibilities - Make outbound marketing and follow-up calls each day to prospective patients, referral contacts, and leads provided by the company. - Explain the company's services, locations, and hours clearly and professionally in English and Spanish. - Follow up on inquiries, missed connections, and referral opportunities until contact is made or the lead is closed out. - Use your knowledge of legal and insurance-related matters to speak confidently with callers, law offices, and other professional contacts, and to recognize when a question needs to be referred to company staff. - Document every call accurately — who was contacted, what was discussed, and the agreed next step — in the company's system. - Meet daily and weekly call and conversion goals, and report results to your supervisor. - Represent the company professionally on every call, following all scripts, privacy, and compliance guidelines provided. Required Qualifications - Bilingual English / Spanish — required. Full fluency in both languages is a must. - Legal experience — required. Prior experience in a law office, legal intake, personal injury, insurance claims, or a related legal setting, with a working knowledge of common legal and claims terminology. - Prior outbound calling, telemarketing, sales, call center, or marketing outreach experience. - Confident, clear, and professional phone manner with strong listening and persuasion skills. - Self-motivated and dependable — able to stay productive and on schedule while working from home without direct supervision. - Basic computer skills, including email, data entry, and working with call lists and customer records. Preferred Qualifications - Experience calling for a medical, chiropractic, or healthcare practice. - Experience working with attorneys, case managers, or referral partners. - Familiarity with customer relationship management (CRM) software or dialer systems. - Experience working fully remotely in a results-based role. Work-From-Home Requirements - A quiet, private home workspace suitable for professional calls. - Reliable high-speed internet and a dependable computer. - A headset or clear phone setup, and the ability to be available during your scheduled hours. Compensation and Schedule Pay: Salary plus commission — earn a base salary with additional commission based on results. Schedule: Monday through Friday. Hours vary by day based on calling schedules and campaign needs. Location: Fully remote — work from home. How to Apply Send your resume to Thepfirmlaw@gmail.com with a brief note about your bilingual ability, your outbound calling / marketing experience, and your legal experience. Please include your availability Monday through Friday. The PFirm, LLC — This posting describes a remote, work-from-home position. Salary and commission details will be discussed during the interview process.

Benefits:

* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

9b6f0290d5b7676db6e6.title: Substation Technician I-III
9b6f0290d5b7676db6e6.description:
We’re looking for **Substation Technicians** who are ready to build their careers supporting complex power systems across the U.S. This hands-on field role involves working on substation projects and related high-voltage infrastructure in power plants, industrial facilities, and renewable energy sites. You’ll perform critical installations, inspections, and troubleshooting alongside experienced professionals who value safety, quality, and performance.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Complete tasks with attention to detail, consistently delivering high-quality work that meets or exceeds industry standards
* Use basic tools such as hypresses and hydraulic pipe benders under supervision
* Assist with fabrication by learning to operate magnetic drills and hydraulic bus punches
* Adhere to all safety procedures and promptly report any unsafe conditions or hazards
* Support daily operations through general labor duties and other responsibilities assigned by supervisors
* Engage in hands-on training and development through classes, homework, and mentorship opportunities
* Contribute to team problem-solving, decision-making, and goal achievement
* Collaborate with team members to drive results and maintain a positive, productive work environment
* Follow PPE protocols and safety procedures while working around high-voltage equipment, at heights, or in confined spaces

**The Experience We’re Looking For:**

* Prior experience working within substation and power plant/manufacturing environments
* Prior experience with construction
* Working knowledge of electrical systems, circuitry, and safety protocols, ensuring adherence to industry standards.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and blueprints
* Proficient in the use of hand and power tools, lifting equipment, and safety gear

**Additional Requirements:**

* High school diploma or GED
* Valid driver’s license with a safe driving history
* Willingness to travel up to 90% based on project needs
* Must pass a background check and drug/alcohol screening
* Physically capable of lifting 50+ lbs. and performing physically demanding work for extended periods
* Able to work outdoors in varying conditions and environments
* Proficiency in English (speaking, reading, writing) for safety and documentation

**Bonus Points for:**

* An associate’s degree in electrical engineering technology, Power Systems, or Mechanical Engineering
* Previous experience with utility companies or substation contractors
* Familiarity with isolated phase bus systems, grounding systems, and relay protection schemes
* Completion of trade school, technical college, or skilled trade certifications

**Why Join RMS Energy:**

We’re not just another power services company. We’re a tight-knit, mission-driven team that values safety, teamwork, innovation, and continuous growth.

* **Competitive Compensation** – Overtime potential and merit-based raises
* **Full Benefits** – Medical, dental, and vision coverage fully paid for employees, starting the month after hire
* **Steady Employment & Career Growth** – Be part of a fast-growing company with promotion potential
* **401(k) with Company Match** – Traditional & Roth options + free investment guidance
* **Top-Tier Equipment** – Provided to support you in the field
* **Compensated Travel Time plus Per Diem** – Earn while seeing new places
* **Education Support** – Paid training, certifications, and industry memberships

MixMode is a leading provider of AI-powered cybersecurity solutions at scale, pioneering a patented third-wave, context-aware AI approach that automatically learns and adapts to dynamic environments. The MixMode platform delivers self-supervised, real-time threat detection for known and unknown threats across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. Large organizations with big data workloads – including those in the US Department of War, US Intelligence Community, Utilities, State/Local and Enterprise – trust MixMode to defend their most important assets. Backed by PSG and Entrada Ventures, MixMode is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at www.mixmode.ai.

**Job Summary:**

MixMode is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our team, remotely or in our Santa Barbara office. This person will own the integration ecosystem for the MixMode platform: the connectors, outbound integrations and data formats that deliver MixMode's AI-driven detections into customers' existing SOC workflows (SIEM, SOAR, ticketing and data lake tools) for investigation and response. They will set direction for this area, partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, and have direct visibility with company leadership.

The ideal candidate is an experienced enterprise product manager with a track record of shipping complex technical products: someone who has owned a product area from problem definition through launch, made and defended hard prioritization calls, and delivered on a cadence. They are comfortable in deep technical conversations with engineers and in front of customers and executives, thrive in a fast-moving startup, turn ambiguity into clear priorities, and write well, because written narratives are how we make decisions.

Security experience is a strong plus, not a requirement.

**What you'll be doing (responsibilities):**

* Drive execution: Own delivery end to end for your product area. Write clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria; work day to day with Engineering and Data Science through design, build and release; manage dependencies, clear blockers and ship what was committed, adjusting as priorities shift.
* Own the roadmap: Define and prioritize the roadmap for the integration ecosystem based on customer needs, market and competitive insight, and business goals; communicate trade-offs and timelines clearly to stakeholders.
* Build the integration ecosystem: Own both directions of the ecosystem.
* + Inbound: the connectors that bring customer telemetry into MixMode (network sensors, cloud audit and flow logs, EDR/XDR, identity, and other security data sources).
  + Outbound: the integrations that deliver MixMode detections into customers' existing workflows (SIEM, SOAR, ticketing and data lake platforms) in the formats customers and partners need.
* Know the customer: Run ongoing discovery with customers, prospects, partners and SOC practitioners; synthesize input from Sales, Customer Success, industry analysts and security research into clear problem statements.
* Measure what matters: Define success metrics for your features (adoption, time to value, integration reliability, retention) and use data to guide iteration.
* Enable go-to-market: Partner with Marketing on positioning, messaging, launches, demos and collateral; train Sales, Sales Engineering and partners; join key customer and prospect conversations.
* Contribute to detection work: Partner with the product and data science teams on how detections are consumed downstream, so what we detect is actionable where customers work.
* Become the expert: Build deep knowledge of the MixMode platform, network and cloud telemetry, and how SOC teams operate, and represent the product with customers, partners, and analysts.

**What you'll need to bring (qualifications):**

* 6+ years of product management experience with enterprise B2B software or SaaS products, with a track record of owning a product area from problem definition through launch and iteration
* Evidence of product judgment: you have made and defended hard prioritization calls, cut scope to ship, and delivered on a cadence, and you can walk us through those decisions in detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable in a writing-first organization where one-pagers, PRDs and PRFAQs drive decisions, and able to explain product vision, strategy and value to technical and executive audiences
* 3+ years owning integration, API, connector or data pipeline products (data ingestion, partner or third-party integrations, marketplace apps, etc.), with hands-on experience in how data moves between systems (ingestion, normalization, schemas, reliability at scale, etc.)
* Experience working day to day with Engineering and Data Science on model-driven or data-driven features
* Strong grounding in the software development lifecycle and Agile methods
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to turn complex technical ideas into clear, actionable plans
* Comfortable with ambiguity and able to work independently in a fast-moving startup environment while collaborating across teams
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Strongly preferred: Experience in cybersecurity, security infrastructure or data platforms, ideally with products that integrate into SIEM, SOC or security analytics workflows

**Other things we'd love to see (nice to have):**

* Working knowledge of at least one SIEM or security data lake platform (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, Elastic, Snowflake)
* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and network or cloud security telemetry (e.g., Zeek, flow logs, CloudTrail)
* Hands-on experience as a software engineer, security analyst or SOC practitioner
* Experience working with federal or public sector customers

We are open to hiring great talent who may have qualifications above or below those specifically listed in this job description. Pursuant to California law, we must display the pay range for this job. Since we are willing to hire within a broad spectrum of qualifications, we also reflect a broad pay range. The base salary range that we are targeting for this position is **$150,000 – $195,000 per year** though we can adjust based on individual qualifications. Individual salary is determined by qualifications, role, level, and location.

**Compensation and benefits** are competitive based on industry standards. Benefits for full-time team members include:

* Remote-First Work Culture
* Healthcare (Medical, Dental, Vision, Accident)
* Basic & Voluntary Life and AD&D
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
