31de40264cfe9fb78f91.title: Recruitment Operations Coordinator
31de40264cfe9fb78f91.description:
The Recruitment Operations Coordinator oversees compliance and onboarding for all new hires across our dispensary locations. This role ensures that every employee has completed the required background checks, obtained state agent badges, and is prepared for their first day with all details finalized. By partnering closely with Talent Acquisition Coordinators, the Recruitment Operations Coordinator guarantees a smooth and compliant onboarding experience for all employees.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

* Manage background checks, agent badge processing, and state compliance requirements.
* Oversee collection and accuracy of pre-hire paperwork, including I-9s.
* Implement and optimize ATS and/or HRIS workflows to reduce manual work and improve data integrity.
* Develop dashboards and KPIs to measure onboarding efficiency, compliance completion, and candidate readiness.
* Audit processes regularly to identify compliance gaps and propose proactive solutions.
* Coordinate with hiring managers and Regional Coordinators to align start dates and communicate first-week schedules to new employees.
* Maintain compliance dashboards and metrics, reporting to TA Leadership and SVP.
* Support and promote diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) across all recruitment activities and leadership pipelines.
* Attain or exceed the hiring performance indicators, including time to fill, candidate quality, retention rate, and others.
* Ensure every candidate’s interaction reflects professionalism, inclusiveness, and alignment with company culture.
* Support audit readiness by ensuring candidate files are complete and legally compliant.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

* 2–3 years of HR operations, recruiting coordination, or onboarding experience.
* SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, or SHRM-CA certification is a plus.
* Experience in cannabis retail or another regulated industry strongly preferred.
* Proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), UKG preferred.
* Demonstrated success using Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, and other advanced sourcing tools to engage high-quality candidates.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage senior-level stakeholders effectively.
* Exceptional organizational and project management skills, capable of supporting multiple regions and up to 90+ retail locations simultaneously.
* Ability to analyze recruiting metrics and reporting - using insights to inform continuous improvement.
* Strong knowledge of state and local compliance considerations unique to cannabis retail (licensing, background checks, badging).
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality, professionalism, and a candidate-first mindset.
* Strong knowledge of onboarding compliance (I-9, E-Verify, agent badges, background checks).
* Ability to pass a background check.
* Ability to travel, as needed.

db18ca6f5829376c6011.title: 340B Operations Specialist
db18ca6f5829376c6011.description:
**Welcome to Clearway Health**- At Clearway Health, we’ve been recognized as a Great Place to Work® for four years in a row—and we’re just getting started. We’re redefining specialty pharmacy by improving access to care, delivering personalized support, and helping patients navigate complex medication needs. Our award-winning culture is built on empowering our people to grow, contribute, and make a difference every day. If you’re driven to create meaningful change and thrive in a collaborative, purpose-driven environment, you’ll fit right in. If you’re looking for a role where you can truly make an impact, keep reading below!

**Position Summary:**

The 340B Operations Specialist is responsible for supporting the day-to-day administration, optimization, and compliance oversight of the 340B Drug Pricing Program across Clearway Health partner health systems and contract pharmacy networks. This role serves as a subject matter expert for 340B operational processes, supporting program integrity, inventory management, split-billing operations, contract pharmacy administration, audit readiness, and stakeholder engagement.

The 340B Operations Specialist collaborates with pharmacy leaders, health system partners, manufacturers, third-party administrators, and internal operational teams to maximize program performance while ensuring compliance with all applicable HRSA regulations and organizational policies.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Lead daily 340B operational activities to ensure accurate program administration, optimization, and compliance for Clearway Health partners.
* Support split-billing software set up for Clearway Health partners and monitor platforms to identify and resolve discrepancies.
* Review, analyze, and understand accumulation data, replenishment transactions, inventory variances and investigate and resolve qualified prescription eligibility issues.
* Analyze program performance metrics and financial outcomes and provide recommendations to optimize performance.
* Prepare recurring operational, compliance, and savings reports including required manufacturer claim reporting.
* Identify trends, opportunities, and potential operational risks through data review.
* Serve as a resource for health system clients, pharmacy staff, and operational teams regarding 340B processes and requirements.
* Collaborate with pharmacy operations, finance, revenue cycle, compliance, and information technology teams.
* Support onboarding and implementation activities for new programs and partnerships.
* Assist with developing and updating policies, procedures, and training materials both internally and externally.
* Participate in client meetings and operational reviews as assigned.
* Maintain knowledge of HRSA regulations, 340B program & legislation changes, and industry best practices.
* Ensure adherence to diversion and duplicate discount prevention requirements.

  

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Pharmacy, Public Health, Finance, or related field required.

  

**Certificates, Licenses, Registrations Required:**

* Advanced 340B Operations Certification

  

**Experience:**

* Minimum 2-4 years of 340B program experience.
* Experience working with 340B split billing and 340B eligible pharmacy systems required
* Experience supporting audits, compliance programs, or healthcare operational initiatives preferred.

  

**Knowledge/Skills:**

* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills required; as well as ability to communicate professionally over the phone.
* Excellent interpersonal skills to provide superb, personalized customer service to instill confidence and advocate for patients; ability to explain required information to customers in a comprehensible manner.
* Organized, strong attention to detail, ability to self-direct through multitasking and prioritizing, dependable, empathetic, focused on quality service, goal oriented.
* Cultural sensitivity, understanding, and comfort with a wide range of social, racial, and ethnic populations.
* Must practice discretion and confidentiality as position deals with extremely sensitive and confidential data.
* Ability to understand, explain, and actively promote the clients' objectives through direct coordination and commitment to the program’s goals.
* Flexibility to adapt to changes in the departmental needs (i.e., assisting other team members, adjusting assignments, etc.).
* High proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook. Ability to quickly learn other relevant applications that support management of patient care and assigned responsibilities; and ability to extract necessary information.

  

**Special Working Conditions (On-call, travel, shift, coverage):**

* Clearway Health Specialty Pharmacies, serving patients in hospitals, health systems, and communities, may require employees at client sites to work on company-recognized holidays.

  

*This information is being provided to promote pay transparency and equal employment opportunities at Clearway Health. The current annual compensation range for this position is $87,000 - $109,000. The actual rate within this range that you will be offered will depend on a variety of factors including geography, skills and abilities, education, experience and other relevant factors. In addition to a competitive base salary, this role is eligible to participate in the company’s bonus program as part of its comprehensive and rewarding benefits package. This opportunity offers a compelling combination of compensation and performance-based incentives designed to recognize and reward contributions.*

*The above statements in this job description are intended to depict the general nature and level of work assigned to the employee(s) in this job. The above is not intended to represent an exhaustive list of accountable duties and responsibilities required. External and internal applicants, as well as position incumbents who become disabled as defined under the Americans with Disabilities Act, must be able to perform the essential job functions (as listed) either unaided or with the assistance of a reasonable accommodation to be determined by management on a case-by-case basis.*

0963d822440049dd9b46.title: Office Manager
0963d822440049dd9b46.description:
**Position Summary**

The Office Manager is responsible for overseeing the daily administrative and operational functions of the home building company. This position plays an important role in keeping the office organized, managing administrative processes, supporting the construction team, coordinating with vendors and subcontractors, and ensuring projects and business operations run efficiently.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, dependable, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple responsibilities in a fast-paced construction environment.

Key Responsibilities

**Office Administration**

* Oversee daily office operations and maintain an organized, professional office environment.
* Answer incoming phone calls, emails, and customer inquiries.
* Manage calendars, appointments, meetings, and company schedules.
* Maintain company files, records, contracts, and documentation.
* Order office supplies and manage office equipment and services.
* Assist ownership and management with administrative projects as needed.

**Construction & Project Support**

* Assist project managers and construction supervisors with administrative needs.
* Maintain and update construction schedules, project files, and job documentation.
* Track permits, inspections, warranties, and other required paperwork.
* Coordinate communication between homeowners, subcontractors, vendors, and the construction team.
* Assist with preparing and organizing purchase orders, work orders, and change orders.
* Help ensure construction documents and project records are accurate and up to date.

**Accounting & Financial Administration**

* Process vendor and subcontractor invoices.
* Assist with accounts payable and accounts receivable.
* Match invoices with purchase orders and verify appropriate approvals.
* Track expenses, receipts, and job-related costs.
* Assist with payroll preparation and employee timekeeping.
* Communicate with the company's bookkeeper or accountant as needed.

**Vendor & Subcontractor Coordination**

* Maintain vendor and subcontractor contact information.
* Assist with obtaining bids and collecting pricing.
* Coordinate paperwork, insurance certificates, W-9s, and other required documents.
* Follow up on outstanding invoices, paperwork, and scheduling needs.
* Help maintain positive working relationships with vendors and subcontractors.

**Customer & Warranty Support**

* Serve as a point of contact for homeowners and prospective customers.
* Assist with customer correspondence and general inquiries.
* Coordinate warranty requests and follow up on outstanding items.
* Maintain organized homeowner files and closing documentation.
* Assist with preparing documents and information for home closings.

**Human Resources & General Business Support**

* Assist with employee onboarding and maintaining personnel records.
* Track employee attendance, time off, and time sheets.
* Help coordinate company meetings and events.
* Maintain confidentiality of company, employee, and customer information.
* Assist ownership with special projects and other business needs.

Qualifications & Experience

* Previous experience in office management, administration, or business operations.
* Experience in residential construction or the home building industry is strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of construction terminology, subcontractors, vendors, and building processes is a plus.
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office, Excel, and Outlook.
* Experience with QuickBooks and/or construction management software preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects.
* Professional, dependable, and able to work independently.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities and enjoys keeping things organized and moving forward. They are a problem solver who sees what needs to be done without always being asked, communicates effectively, follows through on tasks, and works well with both office personnel and construction teams.

This person should be comfortable wearing multiple hats and helping wherever needed to support the success of the company.

Overall Goal of the Position

To provide strong administrative and operational support to ownership and the construction team, allowing the company to operate efficiently, stay organized, provide excellent customer service, and successfully manage its residential home building projects.

Pay: $20.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 24.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

93d873f58af3d6e78e26.title: Coordinator, Executive Office
93d873f58af3d6e78e26.description:

Coordinates activities that support implementation of ASTHO’s strategic plan and performance management system.

* Provides comprehensive administrative support to the DCEO, including scheduling, calendar maintenance, meeting preparation, correspondence, and follow-up
* Coordinates recurring Executive Office and organizational meetings; manage invitations, virtual meeting settings, agendas, materials, and participant communications

ASTHO is headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, and was incorporated on March 23, 1942, with the goal of helping health officials navigate a rapidly changing public health landscape and remains a strong voice in governmental public health.

414fc78cddb1b8e4eb14.title: Compliance Coordinator
414fc78cddb1b8e4eb14.description:
**Job Summary**

NewEdge Advisors, LLC (“NEA”) is a rapidly growing wealth management firm, made up of independent financial advisors that all share the belief that every client is unique and deserves more than ordinary service. Our mission is to give established advisors more time and resources to focus on their clients and practices. We do this by striving to make our advisors’ challenges our own. Supporting our advisors is our only success.

We provide independent financial advisors support with transitions, compliance, real estate solutions, human resources, marketing solutions and technology so that they can focus their attention where it matters most, their clients. When advisors choose to become independent, many believe that the best way to run their practice efficiently and profitably is through partnership, economies of scale and shared resources. NEA serves this market.

NEA is looking for a skilled Compliance Coordinator to assist the compliance department of the firm in coordinating the day to day administrative and workflow items of the team. This position will work with the compliance team members to help keep the team organized, on track, and providing workload balance. The Compliance Coordinator will report directly to the Deputy Chief Compliance Officer.

  

*Location:* New Orleans, LA candidates preferred, but remote candidates will be considered.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Monitor and manage our Salesforce case management system; assign case to subject matter expert, escalate time sensitive and complex items, ensure and monitor for completion, manage CCO and DCCO responses outside the system.
* Phone management; first point of contact for incoming phone calls, transfer calls to available officer, take messages as needed, answer questions as needed.
* Compliance Team Meeting: using meeting notes template, assist the team as primary meeting notetaker, follow up on action items, deadlines, and notices.
* Assist the team with running reports for officer review.
* Assist with setting up new advisors and staff in our compliance system, Orion Compliance
* Establish connections and set up of new employees in our email archiving system, SMARSH; ensure ongoing connection by monitoring the inactive status report and manage communication about re-linking status with employee.
* Meeting scheduling for advisor training, departmental meetings, manager meetings, etc.
* Assist in reviews of verbal verification process and mandatory training, rollover analysis, etc.
* Partner with management and advisors in addressing compliance questions and concerns through thoughtful dialogue and inquiry to ensure proper advice and counsel is provided when needed.
* Provide exceptional service to your clients – the advisors of NEA. Be an advocate and resource for the advisors and staff of NEA.
* Other departmental support as needed.

  

**Skills & Qualifications**

* 4-year Bachelors Degree preferred.
* 1-2 years of securities industry experience preferred.
* Series 65 preferred but not required.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Orion, Orion Compliance (BasisCode), SMARSH, and Salesforce is strongly desired.
* Superior customer service skills in support of the mission of NEA.
* Knowledge of securities industry operations will be preferred.

  

*Salary Range:* $55,000 - $75,000 annually, based on experience, plus eligibility to participate in the company's bonus program

e5751273b6ca57c84a4a.title: Director, Technical Operations
e5751273b6ca57c84a4a.description:
**Who We Are**

Accommodations Plus International (API) is a technology and services company focused on driving innovation across the travel and transportation industry. We partner with organizations in the airline, cruise, and rail sectors to deliver solutions that improve layover operations, enhance customer experience, and support long-term growth.

Our mission is to make layovers simpler and more efficient for crew members—and we bring that to life through deep industry expertise and a practical, results-driven approach.

Today, API’s platform powers over 18 million crew room nights each year for 100+ airlines and travel operators worldwide. Our Global Reach ensures that airline crews are rested, transported, and connected so global aviation runs on time.

At API, we’re building a culture rooted in succeeding and thriving together. It’s a place where people are encouraged to take ownership, develop their skills, and contribute to work that matters.

If you’re looking to grow your career in a company that values steady progress, real impact, and long-term development, we’d like to meet you!

**Summary/Objective**

The Director of Technical Operations is a senior IT leader responsible for the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of API's internal technology environment. This leader oversees all aspects of corporate IT operations, including helpdesk and end-user support, employee hardware lifecycle management, corporate systems administration, enterprise AI tooling ownership, and the tools and processes that keep our global workforce productive every day. Operating across teams in Canada, India, Brazil, and the United States, the Director will lead a team of approximately [X] employees, including [X] direct reports, and manage and develop geographically distributed IT support and systems teams, setting clear service standards and fostering a culture of responsiveness, accountability, and employee-first service delivery. This role requires a seasoned IT operations leader who brings deep experience in enterprise support environments, strong people management skills, and the ability to align internal technology services with the needs of a growing, globally distributed organization.

**Essential Functions:**

*Reasonable* ***accommodations*** *may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

**Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop distributed IT operations teams across Canada, India, Brazil, and the US, fostering a collaborative, service-oriented culture that bridges time zones and delivers a consistent employee experience globally
* Define team structure, staffing levels, roles, and career development frameworks for helpdesk technicians, desktop support engineers, and systems administrators across Canada, India, Brazil, and the US
* Establish clear goals, KPIs, and performance expectations for the IT operations organization; conduct regular performance reviews and provide ongoing coaching and feedback
* Partner with HR and talent acquisition to recruit and retain skilled IT support professionals in Canada, India, Brazil, and the US; build a team capable of scaling to meet growing organizational demand
* Foster a customer-service culture within the IT team, setting expectations for responsiveness, communication quality, and employee satisfaction across all support interactions
* Facilitate cross-functional collaboration between IT operations and HR, Finance, Legal, and business teams to anticipate technology needs and deliver solutions proactively

**Helpdesk & End-User Support**

* Own the global helpdesk function end-to-end, including service desk operations, ticket management, escalation procedures, SLA definitions, and performance reporting for teams in Canada, India, Brazil, and the US
* Administer the helpdesk ticketing and knowledge management tools used by the global support team, ensuring workflows, categorization, and reporting meet organizational needs
* Define and enforce helpdesk SLAs and response time targets; monitor queue performance, ticket aging, and resolution rates, and drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce mean time to resolution (MTTR)
* Establish and maintain a comprehensive, searchable knowledge base and self-service portal to reduce repeat ticket volume and empower employees to resolve common issues independently
* Oversee Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 support workflows, ensuring clear escalation paths and effective knowledge transfer between support levels
* Develop and report on helpdesk metrics and employee satisfaction scores (CSAT) to executive leadership; use data to identify systemic issues and prioritize improvements
* Manage on-call and after-hours support coverage across time zones to ensure critical support needs are addressed outside standard business hours

**Employee Hardware & Asset Management**

* Own the full lifecycle of employee hardware including procurement, provisioning, deployment, tracking, maintenance, refresh, and secure decommissioning for laptops, desktops, mobile devices, peripherals, and other end-user equipment
* Develop and maintain a hardware refresh strategy and multi-year capital plan, ensuring employees in Canada, India, Brazil, and the US are equipped with current, standardized, and reliable devices
* Administer mobile device management (MDM) and endpoint management platforms (such as Jamf, Microsoft Intune, or equivalent) to enforce security policies, manage configurations, and support remote provisioning and wipe capabilities
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date IT asset inventory using asset management tooling; ensure all hardware and software assets are tracked, auditable, and compliant with licensing and security requirements
* Work with the procurement function to manage hardware vendor relationships and purchasing programs; partner on pricing negotiations, warranty and support evaluations, and timely fulfillment for new hires and hardware replacements
* Define and enforce hardware standards for different employee roles and personas (office-based, remote, executive, field); maintain an approved hardware catalog that balances performance, cost, and supportability
* Coordinate onboarding hardware readiness in partnership with HR and People Operations, ensuring new employees in Canada, India, Brazil, and the US receive fully configured, ready-to-use equipment on or before their first day

**Corporate Systems Administration**

* Oversee the administration, availability, and performance of Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, and associated services; ensure the platform is well-governed, properly licensed, and continuously optimized for employee productivity
* Manage identity and access management (IAM) infrastructure, including Ping Identity and Microsoft Entra ID, ensuring employee access is provisioned accurately, reviewed regularly, and deprovisioned promptly at offboarding
* Administer and maintain corporate SaaS application portfolio in coordination with business stakeholders; manage license assignments, user provisioning, vendor relationships, and renewal cycles
* Ensure endpoint security standards are enforced across all corporate devices, including antivirus/EDR, patch management, disk encryption, and security baseline configurations
* Manage corporate file storage, backup, and data retention systems; ensure business data is protected, recoverable, and compliant with relevant data governance policies
* Maintain business continuity and disaster recovery plans for corporate IT systems, including regular testing and documented recovery procedures
* Support security incident response for corporate systems and endpoints in coordination with the security team
* Support audit readiness and compliance requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, or equivalent) as they relate to internal IT systems, access controls, and asset management

**AI Tooling & Ownership**

* Serve as the business owner of the company's enterprise AI tools (such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or equivalent), accountable for tool selection, rollout, configuration, and ongoing performance
* Define and maintain the AI tooling strategy and roadmap, aligned with business priorities and in partnership with executive leadership and the security team
* Establish AI usage governance, including acceptable-use policy, access controls, data-protection and confidentiality standards, and an approval process for new AI tools, integrations, and use cases
* Administer AI platform licensing, user provisioning, and tenant or workspace settings; manage AI vendor relationships, contracts, renewals, and spend
* Partner with Security, Legal, and Compliance to assess AI tool risk, data handling, privacy, and regulatory requirements before and after deployment
* Drive employee adoption through training, enablement, documentation, and internal champions; help teams identify and prioritize high-value AI use cases
* Measure and report AI adoption, usage, cost, and productivity impact to executive leadership; use the data to refine tooling and enablement priorities
* Track the evolving AI tooling landscape; evaluate new tools and capabilities and recommend changes to the AI tool stack

**Strategy, Governance & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Develop and execute the multi-year IT operations roadmap, aligning internal technology capabilities with the company's growth plans, workforce needs, and executive priorities
* Provide regular reporting to the SVP Corporate Technologies and executive leadership team on IT service performance, helpdesk metrics, hardware spend, system availability, and strategic initiative progress
* Manage the IT operations budget, including headcount, hardware procurement, software licensing, and vendor spend; provide accurate forecasting and variance analysis to finance and leadership stakeholders
* Lead technology vendor relationships for hardware and corporate software; oversee contract negotiations, SLA management, and vendor performance reviews
* Establish and maintain IT policies, standards, and procedures covering acceptable use, hardware standards, access management, data handling, and support processes; ensure policies are current, communicated, and enforced
* Lead IT components of new office build-outs, office moves, and facilities technology upgrades, ensuring hardware and systems are ready for occupancy
* Partner with the security team to ensure internal IT practices align with the company's information security program and that corporate systems are appropriately protected and monitored

Competencies

* Proven leadership ability with experience building, scaling, and retaining high-performing IT operations teams across multiple geographies and time zones
* Strong service-delivery orientation with a genuine commitment to employee experience; sets high standards for helpdesk responsiveness, communication quality, and issue resolution
* Executive presence and communication skills; able to translate IT operational metrics and investment needs into clear, compelling narratives for C-suite stakeholders and non-technical audiences
* Skilled at leading geographically distributed teams; experienced navigating the logistical and interpersonal dynamics of cross-timezone collaboration across North America, South America, and Asia
* Data-driven approach to operations management; uses helpdesk metrics, asset data, and service performance KPIs to identify trends, prioritize investments, and report on team effectiveness
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing IT operations budgets covering hardware procurement, software licensing, and staffing, with a track record of cost-effective resource allocation
* Highly organized with strong process discipline; skilled at building repeatable, scalable IT workflows that reduce manual effort and improve consistency across a growing organization

aa3a132952c258379c50.title: Operations Manager (Remote)
aa3a132952c258379c50.description:
**Operations ManagerLead the People, Processes, Systems, and Performance Behind a Growing Immigration Law Firm**

MRA Law Group is seeking an experienced, hands-on **Operations Manager** to lead the day-to-day performance, accountability, systems coordination, and continuous improvement of our Operations Department.

This is a leadership role for someone who knows how to turn expectations into execution.

The Operations Manager will oversee the operational teams responsible for supporting our clients, attorneys, and case production functions, from the first phone call through ongoing client communication, administrative support, document handling, internal operational requests, and systems-related execution.

We are looking for someone who can manage people, build accountability, analyze performance, improve processes, coordinate systems support, solve problems, and create an Operations Department that runs consistently without requiring constant intervention from senior leadership.

**What You Will Own**

**Operations Leadership & Team Management**

You will provide leadership and accountability across the Operations Department, including:

* Operations Team Lead
* Telephone Receptionist Team Lead and Receptionists
* Client CARE Team Lead and Client CARE Agents
* Virtual Assistant
* In-Office Administrative Assistant
* In-Office Legal Assistant
* Systems Administrator
* Systems Developer

You will establish clear expectations, ensure accountability, coach leaders and team members, identify performance issues early, and ensure the department has the structure, workflows, tools, and resources necessary to perform effectively.

You will be expected to manage both people and execution. This includes ensuring that team leaders are leading, frontline employees are meeting expectations, and systems-related support is helping the firm operate faster, cleaner, and more efficiently.

**Operational Performance & Accountability**

You will:

* Establish, monitor, and manage departmental and individual KPIs.
* Review daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly operational performance.
* Hold team leaders accountable for the performance of their respective teams.
* Identify performance trends, bottlenecks, capacity issues, recurring problems, and operational risks.
* Develop corrective action and coaching plans when performance falls below expectations.
* Ensure operational audits are completed and identified issues are addressed.
* Build an environment where ownership, follow-through, and accountability are part of everyday operations.

The current Operations framework measures department efficiency, workflow effectiveness, error reduction, client communication compliance, client satisfaction, complaints, procedure compliance, system usage, documentation accuracy, team KPI achievement, audits, issue-resolution time, process improvement, and operational risk identification.

**Systems, Technology & Operational Infrastructure**

The Operations Manager will play a key leadership role in ensuring the firm’s systems support the way the business actually needs to operate.

You will oversee the Systems Administrator and Systems Developer to ensure that systems, workflows, automations, reports, user access, troubleshooting, and technology improvements are properly prioritized and executed.

You will:

* Ensure operational systems are being used consistently and correctly.
* Translate operational needs into clear systems requirements.
* Coordinate with the Systems Administrator and Systems Developer on workflow improvements, automation opportunities, reporting needs, and system-related issues.
* Ensure system changes are aligned with operational goals and do not create unnecessary disruption.
* Monitor system usage, documentation accuracy, and compliance with required workflows.
* Identify gaps between process design, system capability, and actual team execution.
* Help prioritize technology improvements based on business impact, urgency, and scalability.
* Ensure systems-related projects are completed with clear ownership, timelines, testing, rollout, and follow-through.

This role does not require the Operations Manager to be a programmer. However, it does require someone who can understand operational problems, ask the right questions, manage systems-related priorities, and ensure technology supports performance instead of becoming another bottleneck.

**Client Experience**

Our Operations Department plays a major role in how clients experience MRA Law Group.

You will ensure:

* Client calls and communications are handled professionally and promptly.
* Reception and Client CARE teams consistently meet service expectations.
* Client concerns are identified, documented, and escalated appropriately.
* Communication breakdowns do not become preventable client complaints.
* Operational issues contributing to cancellations, dissatisfaction, or refund exposure are identified and addressed.
* Client feedback and satisfaction trends are monitored and converted into practical operational improvements.

**Processes & Continuous Improvement**

We do not want someone who simply maintains existing processes. We want someone who asks:

**Why are we doing it this way, is it working, and can we do it better?**

You will:

* Develop, document, implement, and continuously improve SOPs and workflows.
* Ensure consistent use of the firm’s case management system, trackers, and operational tools.
* Ensure tasks, communications, and activities are properly documented.
* Identify unnecessary steps, duplicated work, bottlenecks, process gaps, and ownership gaps.
* Translate operational problems into practical, measurable solutions.
* Implement improvements and measure whether they actually worked.
* Identify operational risks before they become larger client, legal, financial, or business problems.

The right person for this role will not treat process improvement as theory. You should be able to move from observation to diagnosis, from diagnosis to action, and from action to measurable results.

**Cross-Department Collaboration**

Operations does not operate in a silo.

You will work closely with attorneys, Case Production, HR, Finance, leadership, and other departments to ensure operational processes support efficient case progression, strong client service, and scalable firm growth.

You will be expected to identify where handoffs are breaking down, clarify ownership, resolve workflow issues, and help different functions work together more effectively.

**What We’re Looking For**

Our ideal Operations Manager has:

* Proven experience leading an Operations, Customer Service, Client Services, Administrative, Legal Operations, Systems Operations, or similar multi-function team.
* Experience managing both frontline employees and team leaders or supervisors.
* Experience overseeing systems, technology workflows, operational tools, or systems-support personnel is strongly preferred.
* Strong people-management, coaching, delegation, and accountability skills.
* Experience establishing and managing KPIs, scorecards, service levels, and performance standards.
* Strong process-improvement and problem-solving capability.
* Experience creating or improving SOPs, workflows, documentation standards, and operational systems.
* Confidence using data, reports, dashboards, and performance trends to make operational decisions.
* Strong organizational and project-management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* The ability to manage multiple priorities without losing visibility or accountability.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced environment where client needs and priorities can change quickly.
* Strong judgment and the ability to distinguish between something that requires leadership escalation and something Operations should simply solve.

Experience working within a law firm, immigration practice, professional-services organization, or high-volume client-service environment is strongly preferred.

**The Person Who Will Thrive Here**

You are probably a strong fit if you:

* Naturally create structure where there is complexity.
* Do not need senior leadership to repeatedly remind you about deadlines, deliverables, or follow-through.
* Believe that delegation still requires accountability.
* Can be supportive of employees without avoiding difficult performance conversations.
* Investigate the root cause instead of repeatedly fixing the same symptom.
* Are comfortable challenging inefficient processes.
* Understand that a great client experience depends heavily on what happens behind the scenes.
* Can manage managers, not just individual contributors.
* Can work with systems and technology teams without losing sight of operational outcomes.
* Know how to use metrics without losing sight of the people behind them.
* Take ownership when something falls within your department.

**Why MRA Law Group?**

MRA Law Group is an immigration law firm serving individuals and families navigating complex immigration matters, including family-based and humanitarian immigration cases.

The Operations Manager occupies a critical leadership seat within the firm. Your work will directly influence client experience, employee performance, attorney support, case progression, systems execution, operational scalability, and the firm’s ability to grow without sacrificing service quality.

We are not looking for someone to simply keep Operations busy.

We are looking for someone who can make Operations deliver excellent performance consistently.

If you are a hands-on operations leader who can manage people, improve processes, oversee systems execution, and help build a stronger operational foundation for growth, we encourage you to apply.

Pay: $30.00 - $40.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Experience:

* Operations Management: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

Job Description
  
  
Associate Director, Patient Support Digital & Data Strategy - US Marketing Immunology
  
**Job Title:** Data PSP Ecosystem Strategy Lead
  
**Department:** Immunology Patient Support Program / Brand
  
**Reporting To:** Patient Support Strategy Lead
  
**Location:** Upper Gwynedd, PA (Hybrid)
  
  
Our company is dedicated to delivering innovations that extend and improve the lives of patients worldwide. Our team of dauntless, forward-thinking individuals achieves this through an unwavering commitment to supporting accessibility to medicine, providing new therapeutic options, and collaborating with governments and payers to ensure that people who need medicines have access to them.
  
  
We have a proud legacy of developing novel therapeutics for people with immune-mediated inflammatory diseases and autoimmune-related disorders. With an advanced understanding of human biology, there's been an emergence of innovative medicines and new modalities that aim to change the way we approach treatment for immune disorders. Our scientists are investigating ways to modulate tumor necrosis factor-like ligand 1A (TL1A) to potentially address inflammation and fibrosis associated with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). Our scientists are investigating TL1A, which has been shown to be increased in inflamed intestinal tissue and in the systemic circulation of patients with IBD.
  
  
IBD is a chronic inflammatory condition affecting the digestive tract and impacting nearly three million people in the U.S. Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis are two of the most common forms of IBD. The unpredictable symptoms associated with IBD, which may include diarrhea, abdominal pain, unintended weight loss and fatigue, often create emotional and social challenges for those impacted.
  
  
The Associate Director, Patient Support Digital & Data Strategy - US Marketing Immunology is responsible for shaping the brand-side PSP data strategy across the ecosystem, including data design, measurement, CRM decisions, and operational readiness. This role serves as the brand PSP data subject matter expert and helps ensure that the data architecture, reporting, and measurement approach enable a coherent, patient-centered support experience. The role partners closely with the Patient Support Strategy Lead and cross-functional teams to support integration across Hub, FRM, SP, ISP, Nursing processes, and business rules.
  
This individual collaborates with brand, digital, data, operations, and implementation partners to define data requirements, support CX data enablement, and ensure the PSP ecosystem is designed to support launch readiness and long-term optimization. The role will use business priorities, customer journey insights, operational needs, and measurement requirements to shape the PSP data ecosystem and drive informed decision-making.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities:**  

* Serve as the brand PSP data SME to shape end-to-end data strategy, design, and ecosystem mapping for PSP solutions.
* Drive CX data enablement across key customer groups.
* Serve as the brand-side lead for CRM decisions and enablement.
* Service as brand lead for HCP portal and digital enrollment strategies – lead user experience design and functionality of HCP portal.
* Ensure alignment and integration with Hub, FRM, SP, ISP, Nursing processes, and business rules.
* Support end-to-end integration and operational readiness, including testing, for launch.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to translate PSP strategy into data and measurement requirements.
* Support the development of a PSP program measurement framework and dashboards.
* Contribute to CRM-related business decisions, business rules, and process design to ensure a consistent and scalable ecosystem.
* Help identify dependencies and gaps across operational partners and escalate issues that may affect launch readiness or customer experience.
* Use launch learnings, measurement outputs, and channel performance insights to recommend future data and ecosystem enhancements.

This is a hybrid role based on Upper Gwynedd, PA, with an expectation of working on-site three days per week.
  
  
**Required Education:**  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent (BA/BS). Advanced degree preferred.

**Required Experience:**  

* 7+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical/biotechnology or healthcare industry, including experience in data strategy, CRM, operations, digital, patient support, or related areas.
* Experience with patient support programs, CRM enablement, data design, or measurement frameworks strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into data, measurement, or ecosystem requirements.
* Experience working in matrixed organizations and leading cross-functional initiatives.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Demonstrated strategic thinking with the ability to balance business objectives, patient experience, and operational feasibility.
* Demonstrates high degree of integrity and ethics.
* Resilient, adaptable, and comfortable operating in ambiguity; growth mindset.

**Preferred Experience & Skills:**  

* Awareness and understanding of U.S. commercial, legal, regulatory, privacy, and compliance considerations applicable to patient support programs.
* Understanding of and/or experience directly working within the Immunology market.
* Familiarity with specialty patient support ecosystems and CRM-enabled patient engagement journeys.
* Experience with data architecture, ecosystem mapping, measurement design, dashboards, and testing/implementation support.
* Experience supporting launch readiness and lifecycle evolution of patient support programs.
* Experience partnering with digital, analytics, operations, and vendor teams.
* Experience with business rules development, CRM platforms, and operational readiness processes.

**Required Skills:**  

* Adaptability, Agile Methodology, Business Decisions, Communication, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Strategy, Decision Making, Digital Engagement, HCP Experience, Market Access, Marketing, Omnichannel Engagement, Patient Engagement, Patient Experience, Patient Support, Pharmaceutical Industry, Strategic Thinking.

**Required Skills:**

9a590276c0333571182b.title: Director - Patient Support Center Operations
9a590276c0333571182b.description:
Schweiger is one of the leading dermatology practices in the country with over 580+ healthcare providers and over 170+ offices in New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Connecticut, Florida, Illinois, Missouri, Minnesota, and California. Schweiger provides medical, cosmetic, and surgical dermatology and allergy services with over 2.5 million patient visits annually.  
  
Our mission is to create the *Ultimate Patient Experience* and a great working environment for our providers, support staff and all team members.  
  
Schweiger has been included in the *Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies in America* list for seven consecutive years. Schweiger has also received *Great Place to Work* certification. To learn more, click here.

  

**Schweiger's Ultimate Employee Experience****:**

* Positive work environment with the tools you need to do your job and grow
* Full time employees *(30+ hours per week)* are eligible for:
  + Medical (*Virtual Care included)*, HSA/FSA, Dental, Vision on 1st of the month after hire date
  + 401K after 30 days of employment
  + Company Sponsored Short Term Disability (*Only applicable for non-California employee*)
  + Pre-tax savings available for public transit commuters
  + Your birthday is an additional personal holiday
* Part-time employees *(less than 30 hours)* are eligible for:
  + Dental and Vision on 1st of the month after date of hire
  + 401K after 30 days of employment
* Employee discounts on Schweiger skin care products & cosmetic services

**Job Summary:** Lead the Patient Support Center for one of the country's largest dermatology groups — roughly 50,000 calls and 35,000 texts a week, a 150-person department, two BPO partners, and an operation where AI voice agents and automated quality monitoring are already live, not on a roadmap. We're looking for a culture builder who sees what could work better and has the drive to make it happen.

We're looking for a strategic, inventive leader to run our Patient Support Center and shape where it goes next. You'll own patient communication across voice, chat, and text — the experience patients get, the culture the team works in, and how efficiently the whole operation runs.

What makes this job different is how much technology is already in the mix. AI voice agents handle patient calls today. Automated quality monitoring reviews interactions at a scale no QA team could. Self-service and automation keep expanding. None of this is a roadmap slide — it's live, it's changing, and the Director helps deliver what comes ne*xt.*

**Job Responsibilities**

* **Build the culture.** Create an environment where people feel supported, take pride in their work, and know what good looks like. Develop managers who coach consistently, recognize strong work, address performance honestly, and grow their teams. Hold the same bar across our BPO partners so patients get one consistent experience.
* **Own the patient experience.** Quality, responsiveness, and consistency across voice, chat, and text. Empathetic support, accurate information, real resolution. Work with the Experience Supervisor to turn patient feedback and service failures into fixes that stick.
* **Deliver** Stay close to patients and frontline staff, challenge processes that are harder than they need to be, and bring practical solutions forward. Then set owners and timelines, test, learn, and scale what works — without letting daily performance slip.
* **Lead in an AI-heavy environment.** Partner with technology, analytics, and operations to improve AI and automation across the operation. Help your team work confidently as the tools change, and measure honestly whether each change actually improved patient experience, employee workload, productivity, or cost.
* **Run a disciplined operation.** Hit volume, handle time, service level, and response time targets alongside experience and quality goals. Own forecasting, staffing, scheduling, capacity, and budget. Anticipate how shifts in demand and technology change what the department needs.
* **Hold partners accountable.** Manage two BPO relationships with clear expectations for service, quality, productivity, staffing, training, and retention. Build good relationships, address gaps directly, make improvements stick.
* **Improve the full patient journey.** Listen to calls, review digital interactions, use our channels yourself. Partner with clinics and support teams on scheduling accuracy, handoffs, escalations, and follow-up. Feed what you learn back into coaching and root-cause fixes.
* Other duties as assigned by supervisor on an as needed basis.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree required.
* 5+ years of management experience required, 8+ years contact center experience required.
* Contact center leadership at comparable scale and complexity — a large team led through multiple managers, plus outsourced partners.
* Experience across both voice and digital channels (chat, text, or messaging).
* A track record of building strong team cultures and developing managers who can lead on their own.
* Hands-on involvement deploying and managing contact center technology, especially AI and automation. You don't need to be technical; you do need to be comfortable and curious.
* Real command of workforce planning, quality assurance, coaching, performance management, and budgeting.
* Changes you personally lead from idea through adoption to measurable, sustained results.
* Healthcare or patient access experience is a plus, not a requirement. We'll teach you dermatology.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA & OSHA compliance

**Travel**

While primarily a remote position, there could be events or business needs that require employee to attend in-person team meetings.

Compensation Range: $122,000-$142,000

*This remote position is open to candidates located in the following states: New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Connecticut, Florida, Illinois, Missouri, Minnesota, and California.*

Schweiger, is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in its hiring process with applicants, whether internal or external, because of race, creed, color, age, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, genetic information, veteran status, military status, application for military service or any other class per local, state or federal law.
  
  
Schweiger does not require vaccination for COVID-19 in order to be considered for employment; however, some state guidelines may require that we keep record of your vaccination status on file.

3017dae42915935d3e63.description:
Secur-Serv is a leading managed services provider of IT, print, and hardware services, with a security focus at the core of every service. Secur-Serv provides nationwide, on-site service to businesses of every size, focusing on the financial, manufacturing, transportation, and healthcare industries.

Secur-Serv is headquartered in Omaha, NE, and able to service our customers throughout the continental United States and Canada

Why Secur-Serv?

Join Secur-Serv because we are committed to professional and personal growth, working with employees to develop a defined career path and helping them achieve their career goals with internal and external training and tuition reimbursement. We empower our employees to innovate and be a part of solutions that improve processes, systems, and transformation. We recognize and provide an environment where each and every employee can make an impact.

* We have a generous benefits package for our full-time employees, which includes a copay medical plan option, HSA medical plans with employer contributions to your HSA Account, dental, vision, company-paid life insurance, and company-paid short- and long-term disability coverage.
* Plan for your future with Secur-Serv’s 401K savings plan with a generous company match. You are vested on your first day of eligibility in the plan.
* Participate in our wellness program to improve your health and earn a discount on your health insurance premiums.
* Explore new education and training opportunities with our Tuition Reimbursement Plan which covers up to $5,250.

***This is a remote, work-from-home position, and all qualified candidates are encouraged to apply in the continental U.S., with the exception of candidates from Colorado, California, Washington, Maryland, Hawaii, New York, Maine, Illinois, Virginia, Connecticut, DC, Vermont, or New Jersey.***  
  
**POSITION SUMMARY**  
The Help Desk Operations Manager is responsible for quality and customer experience with our Managed IT Help Desk. The role requires management of support tickets, workflows and team collaboration with Help Desk technicians and managers in a fast-paced, technical environment. This is a client-facing position with daily interaction involving customer satisfaction, scheduling, escalation, and relationship building.  
  
**ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES**  
**Customer Focus**

* Work customer tickets as needed/available.
* Assist technicians with technical or customer needs.
* Maintain scheduled ticket status and scheduled service calls.
* Follow-up as first Point of Contact for negative ticket survey response.

***Project Management***

* Monitor all active Help Desk tickets to ensure quality.
* Watch Service Level Agreement for all technicians.
* Watch communication metric for all technicians.
* Move/escalate tickets for technical or availability resolution.
* Move/escalate tickets to meet service level agreements.
* Assist in inter-department ticket assignment.
* Balance Help Desk technician workload
* Schedule / dispatch Field Service tickets and coordinate materials
* Provide first Point of Contact for Field Service escalation.

***Management of Staff***

* Build team cohesion and best-in class customer support culture and foster a positive and energetic high-performing team coaching.
* Plans, directs, and coordinates the efforts of assigned staff members toward attainment of goals and objectives.
  + Develops staff.
    - Provides advice and guidance to staff regarding client relationships and projects.
    - Identifies developmental and growth opportunities for staff members.
    - Ensures appropriate training is provided to staff.
* Provides coaching, communication, feedback and completes formal performance appraisals for each assigned staff member.
* Participates in the selection process for new employees to ensure adequate staffing.
* Manage team members to achieve all goals while following all corporate policies and procedures.
* Develops and maintains an environment that is optimal for employee productivity, employee engagement and job satisfaction.
* Provide consistent clear communication and direction to the operations staff and management.
* Coordinate with Manager and the People Department to determine appropriate disciplinary actions for performance conduct quality attendance or other actions that are deemed inappropriate or non-productive.
* Prepare and conduct periodic performance reviews.

***Administration***

* Implements and sustains process improvement.

**REQUIREMENTS**  
***Education / Experience***

* High School Diploma or GED
* 2 years of IT Management experience
* 2 years of Call Center experience
* Experience in leading a team, including hiring, training, and performance management.
* Basic understanding of project management principles to oversee help desk initiatives.
* Ability to develop training programs and materials for help desk staff.
* Experience in managing budgets and controlling costs related to help desk operations.
* Proficiency in generating and analyzing reports to track help desk performance and identify areas for improvement.

***Skills***

* Understanding of IT systems, networks, and hardware/software troubleshooting and proficiency in using MS Office applications.
* Ability to handle customer issues professionally and efficiently.
* Capacity to identify, analyze, and resolve complex technical issues.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills for interacting with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.

***Other Requirements***

* Be part of On-Call rotation

**PREFERRED SKILLS/EXPERIENCE**

* Familiarity with ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library) practices for service management.
* Experience in managing relationships with external vendors and service providers

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS/WORKING CONDITIONS**

* Extended use of computer monitor
* General office environment

WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Applicants who have disabilities may request that accommodations be made in order to complete the selection process by contacting our People Department by emailing Hiring@secur-serv.com or calling 402.697.3039.

EEO is the law. To review your rights under Equal Employment Opportunity please visit: www.dol.gov/ofccp/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/eeopost.pdf.
