271737c7d455c85d313d.title: Representative - Patient Access L1
271737c7d455c85d313d.description:
Atlas Healthcare Partners exists to form strategic partnerships with health systems across the nation to develop, manage and operate Ambulatory Surgery Centers (ASCs) in their markets. As a key player in this rapidly growing healthcare segment, we are committed to providing exceptional care and outstanding customer service to every patient, every physician, every time. Our daily focus revolves around our core values of Integrity, Culture, Teamwork, Respect, and Results.
  
In addition to fostering a workplace that encourages professional growth and advancement, we provide industry-leading health and dental benefits, paired with a matching retirement package. We look forward to you being a vital part of our journey in shaping the future of healthcare.
  
  
POSITION SUMMARY
  
The Patient Access Representative verifies demographic and insurance information, completes coordination of benefit changes, calculates patient estimates, verifies the accuracy of the surgery prior authorization, and collects patient financial obligations. The individual utilizes a complex skill set and verifies every scheduled patient surgery and is ultimately responsible for assisting patients and families. Works as a member of a team to ensure reimbursement for services in a timely and accurate manner.
  
  
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  

* Confirm valid coverage for services and location by contacting insurance companies and/or review electronic responses for benefit information
* Manage patient insurance demographic information to verify authorization obligations.
* Verify that service is a covered benefit, based on knowledge of the specific insurance plan, the specific benefit package restrictions, and the timing of the service
* Understand patient deductibles, out of network referrals and out of pocket limitations.
* Review the account and timing of last patient demographic query to identify missing standard and/or required information. If necessary, contact the patient to complete the information.
* Calculate and collect patient liability before or at the time of service. Communicate the liability and explain the calculation low and high amounts when necessary.
* Identify the potential need for assistance when the coverage/benefit is either inadequate or nonexistent for a medically necessary service, and if necessary, create a payment plan with the patient and document the agreement appropriately.
* Answer automated call center calls and determine whether an outbound call is necessary, either to the patient or to the insurance company. For a call back, assess the call and respond appropriately, attempting to resolve all patient inquiries
* Builds strong working relationships with assigned business units, hospital departments or provider offices. Identifies trends in payment issues and communicates with internal and external customers as appropriate to educate and correct problems. Provides assistance and excellent customer service to these internal clients.
* Responds to incoming calls and makes outbound calls as required to resolve billing, payment and accounting issues. Provides assistance and excellent customer service to patients, patient families, providers, and other internal and external customers

Performs all functions according to established policies, procedures, regulatory and accreditation requirements, as well as applicable professional standards. Provides all customers with an excellent service experience by consistently demonstrating our core and leader behaviors each and every day.
  
  
**NOTE:** The essential functions are intended to describe the general content of and requirements of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. Specific tasks or responsibilities will be documented as outlined by the incumbent's immediate manager.
  
  
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  

* High school diploma /GED or equivalent working knowledge.
* Requires knowledge of one or more of the following: patient financial services or collecting service processes normally acquired over up to two years of work experience.
* Requires the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously with minimal supervision and to work independently.
* Requires strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills to effectively interact with a wide range of audiences.
* Strong knowledge in the use of common office software, word processing, spreadsheet, and database software are required.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) may be required based on market(s) assignment. Must be able to speak, read, and communicate fluently in Spanish to support patient financial counseling, benefit explanation, and pre service communication.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Work experience with the Company’s systems and processes is preferred. Previous cash collections experience is preferred. Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS/ENVIRONMENT FACTORS
  
**OE - Typical Office Environment:** (Accountant, Administrative Assistant, Consultant, Program Manager)
  

* Requires extensive sitting with periodic standing and walking.
* May be required to lift up to 20 pounds.
* Requires significant use of personal computer, phone and general office equipment.
* Needs adequate visual acuity, ability to grasp and handle objects.
* Needs ability to communicate effectively through reading, writing, and speaking in person or on telephone.
* May require off-site travel

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
  

* None

DIRECTLY REPORTING
  

* Reports to the Supervisor – Patient Access

TYPE OF SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
  

* N/A

SCOPE AND COMPLEXITY
  

* Works independently under general supervision, following defined standards and procedures. Reports to a Supervisor or Manager. Uses critical thinking skills to solve problems and reconcile accounts in a timely manner. External customers include all ambulatory surgery center patients, patient families and all third-party payers. Internal customers include facility medical records and patient financial services staff, attorneys, and central services staff members.

29157dbe58fe8acf42e5.title: Security & EHS Operations Manager
29157dbe58fe8acf42e5.description:
Our collective future depends on carbon-free transportation. To forge that future, Voltera develops, owns, and operates the infrastructure that enables companies to succeed at scale with zero-emission vehicles. We're looking for innovative, people-first team members who understand that culture is critical in our effort to positively impact the world's transition to a carbon-free transportation future.

Voltera is seeking a Security & EHS Operations Manager to lead day-to-day security and environmental, health, and safety (EHS) operations across all of Voltera's workplace and commercial locations nationwide. This is a hands-on, full-time role, not a purely strategic one: you will directly supervise the Security Desk and embedded security staff, own the technology that runs physical security day to day, and build out the data and reporting function that gives leadership visibility into both programs.

You should be comfortable working hands-on with security-specific technology and systems on a daily basis, and equally comfortable managing the outsourced EHS expertise that supports workplace safety and the environmental requirements that come with operating EV charging sites. You don't need to be the technical EHS expert yourself; you need to understand the requirements well enough to manage that vendor relationship and make sure its guidance translates into real execution on the ground. This role also partners closely with the teams supporting a site's full development lifecycle — Real Estate, Development, and Construction — with People Operations and Workplace teams supporting Voltera's distributed worker base, and with customer security and safety teams at partner locations.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

**Security Operations**

* Directly supervise 24/7 Security Desk operations, including scheduling, performance, and day-to-day direction of embedded security staff.
* Own and operate Voltera's core security technology stack nationwide — access control & badging systems, video management systems (VMS), and visitor management systems — including user provisioning, credentialing, and system health.
* Coordinate incident response, investigations, and post-incident reporting across all locations.
* Manage third-party physical security consulting engagements, including scope, deliverables, and program design and execution.
* Evaluate and expand security coverage models — embedded staffing, technology, and patrol — as new and newly acquired sites come online.
* Own security-related vendor budgets, invoicing, and SOW/PO administration.

**Data & Reporting (Security + EHS)**

* Own the data and reporting function for both security and EHS programs, building and maintaining the metrics, dashboards, and reporting cadence leadership uses to track both — pulling in vendor-supplied data as a key input.
* Serve as the source of truth for security and EHS KPIs — incidents, access activity, audit findings, and vendor performance — across the nationwide portfolio.
* Standardize status reporting and escalation flags so open issues in either function surface quickly.

**Work Order & Vendor Coordination (Security + EHS)**

* Issue and manage work orders for security device service calls — access control, cameras, visitor management hardware, and alarm systems — through Voltera's CMMS.
* Issue and manage work orders for safety and environmental equipment inspections and servicing — fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, eyewash stations, AEDs, spill kits, and similar life-safety and environmental equipment.
* Coordinate with the Facilities team on incidents that require facility repairs — damaged doors, gates, locks, or other physical damage resulting from a security or EHS event.
* Manage vendor relationships and SLAs for security and EHS equipment maintenance, inspection, and repair, tracking completion alongside other security and EHS KPIs.

**EHS Operations**

* Own and manage the vendor relationship and platform — Voltera's primary source of EHS technical expertise — and lead its expansion to commercial sites nationwide.
* Serve as the operational point of contact for EHS-specific vendors and software tools, translating their technical guidance into day-to-day execution across the portfolio.
* Partner with EHS vendors to maintain compliance with OSHA and applicable state/local workplace safety regulations across all workplace and commercial locations.
* Leverage vendor expertise to manage environmental compliance requirements across the portfolio — hazardous materials handling, spill prevention and control (SPCC) plans, stormwater management, and environmental permitting related to charging equipment, battery storage, and backup power systems — ensuring vendor recommendations are implemented on the ground.
* Coordinate with EHS vendors to develop and maintain emergency response, site evacuation, and spill/hazmat response plans, and lead staff training and drills.
* Lead safety and environmental incident reporting, investigation, and corrective action tracking, pulling in vendor expertise where technical review is needed.
* Coordinate recurring safety and environmental compliance audits and risk assessments nationwide, partnering with EHS vendors on technical assessment and ensuring findings are tracked to closure.

**Program Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with the Real Estate, Development, and Construction teams across a site's full development lifecycle — from pre-development through construction and into operations — to plan security and EHS requirements at each phase.
* Design and manage an integrated guarding strategy that makes the best use of vendor resources across project phases, from construction-site security through steady-state operational coverage.
* Partner with customer security teams at partner and host locations to improve information sharing and operational efficiencies.
* Partner with People Operations and Workplace teams to ensure safe and secure working environments for Voltera's distributed worker base.
* Partner with Facilities, Charging Operations, and the Operations Program Team to align security and EHS coverage with site activity.
* Support the evaluation of embedded security staff.
* Represent security and EHS in planning for new site activation, portfolio expansion, and integration of newly acquired locations.
* Manage department budget across CapEx, OpEx, and SG&A in partnership with Director and Finance.

  

**MUST-HAVE:**

* 3-5+ years of experience in physical security operations, with EHS experience also valued — ideally across a multi-site, nationwide commercial or industrial environment.
* Hands-on, day-to-day proficiency with access control & badging systems, video management systems (VMS), and visitor management systems is required.
* Experience directly supervising 24/7 security desk or similar operations, including embedded or outsourced staff.
* Comfortable and adept working with security-specific technology; quick to learn new systems and platforms.
* Working familiarity with OSHA and environmental compliance concepts sufficient to manage an EHS vendor relationship and oversee program execution; deep technical EHS expertise is not required, as this is supported by an outsourced EHS partner.
* Experience managing outsourced technical vendors or consultants and translating their guidance into operational execution.
* Experience building or owning reporting/data functions — dashboards, KPIs, and recurring status reporting.
* Strong vendor management, budgeting, and invoice reconciliation skills.
* Experience issuing and tracking work orders through a CMMS, and coordinating with Facilities teams on repair needs stemming from security or EHS incidents.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and present to leadership.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
* Strong independent organizational and communication skills — comfortable operating with minimal day-to-day oversight across a distributed, nationwide team.
* Ability to travel to sites nationwide as needed.

**NICE-TO-HAVE:**

* GSOC (Global Security Operations Center) experience or alarm monitoring software experience.
* Certifications such as CPP (Certified Protection Professional), CSP (Certified Safety Professional), or OSHA 30.
* Experience with CMMS platforms.
* Experience operating in a high-growth or M&A integration environment.
* Experience in EV, energy, or critical infrastructure industries.

  

**LOCATION:** Remote (U.S.-based), with up to 25% travel required.

  

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:**  
  
The base salary range for this role is $105,000 - $125,000. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. Our total compensation and benefits package is designed to support employees both personally and professionally. It includes:

* Competitive base salary
* Annual bonus opportunity
* Incentive equity compensation
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company matching
* Unlimited vacation time
* 11 paid company holidays
* Monthly health and wellness stipend
* Monthly phone and internet stipend
* Paid Parental Leave
* Electric vehicle incentive

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Voltera believes diversity – of thought, backgrounds, and experiences – affects all that we do, from our employees to the solutions we deliver. Our goal is to create an environment in which inclusion through diversity helps deepen the lives and work experience of our employees, enhances our innovation and creativity, and enriches our involvement in our communities. Voltera is an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, as well as any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

6b1f82528acda63065b4.title: Director, Cloud Infrastructure
6b1f82528acda63065b4.description:
**Who We Are**

Accommodations Plus International (API) is a technology and services company focused on driving innovation across the travel and transportation industry. We partner with organizations in the airline, cruise, and rail sectors to deliver solutions that improve layover operations, enhance customer experience, and support long-term growth.

Our mission is to make layovers simpler and more efficient for crew members—and we bring that to life through deep industry expertise and a practical, results-driven approach.

Today, API’s platform powers over 18 million crew room nights each year for 100+ airlines and travel operators worldwide. Our Global Reach ensures that airline crews are rested, transported, and connected so global aviation runs on time.

At API, we’re building a culture rooted in succeeding and thriving together. It’s a place where people are encouraged to take ownership, develop their skills, and contribute to work that matters.

If you’re looking to grow your career in a company that values steady progress, real impact, and long-term development, we’d like to meet you!

**Summary/Objective**

The Senior Director of Cloud Infrastructure & Technical Operations is the senior technical authority for the reliability, scalability, performance, and security of API's cloud-based platform and infrastructure. This is a hands-on, player-coach role: an expert AWS architect and network engineer who also leads people. Operating globally, the Senior Director will set and review AWS architecture, including multi-account design, hybrid and multi-region networking, and security controls, while developing distributed cloud, network, SRE, and DevOps teams. The role owns AWS governance, system reliability, and service continuity, and serves as the primary bridge between technology operations and the business. The ideal candidate combines deep, current AWS and cloud networking expertise with strong people leadership, financial acumen, and executive partnership skills.

**Essential Functions:**

*Reasonable* ***accommodations*** *may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

**Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop globally distributed technical operations teams, building a collaborative, high-performance culture across time zones and cultures
* Define team structure, roles, and career paths for cloud engineers, network engineers, SREs, and DevOps practitioners across both locations
* Serve as the technical escalation point and mentor for cloud and network engineers; take part directly in architecture reviews, major incident response, and root-cause analysis
* Set goals, KPIs, and performance expectations for the organization; conduct regular reviews and provide ongoing coaching
* Partner with HR and talent acquisition to recruit and retain top technical talent across our global locations
* Collaborate with product engineering, security, data, and business teams to integrate operational requirements into the software development lifecycle

**Cloud Infrastructure & AWS**

* Serve as the senior technical authority for API's global AWS environment and own its governance and operations, including multi-account strategy (Organizations, Control Tower), security controls, compliance posture, and cost management
* Drive cloud cost optimization, including Reserved Instance and Savings Plans management, rightsizing, tagging governance, and FinOps practices
* Establish and enforce AWS security best practices including IAM least-privilege access, SCPs, GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, and CloudTrail audit logging across all environments
* Oversee multi-region and multi-AZ strategies that meet disaster recovery objectives, minimize RTO/RPO, and maintain continuous availability for global customers
* Evaluate new AWS services and infrastructure technologies and present adoption recommendations to senior leadership
* Define infrastructure as code standards (Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK), CI/CD-driven change, and Well-Architected reviews

**Cloud Network Architecture & Engineering**

* Architect and hold final technical accountability for AWS network design, including multi-account/multi-VPC topologies, CIDR planning, segmentation, Transit Gateway routing, PrivateLink, and centralized egress and inspection
* Own hybrid connectivity between AWS, API's global offices, and partners, including Direct Connect, Site-to-Site and Client VPN, and BGP routing and failover design
* Design and operate DNS, edge, and traffic management, including Route 53, CloudFront, Global Accelerator, and Elastic Load Balancing
* Define network security architecture, including security groups, NACLs, Network Firewall, WAF, Shield, zero-trust access, and segmentation of PCI-scoped workloads
* Establish network observability and resilience using VPC Flow Logs, Reachability Analyzer, and CloudWatch/Datadog; lead troubleshooting of complex cross-region and hybrid incidents and validate network failover during DR testing

**System Reliability & Service Continuity**

* Define and own SLAs and uptime commitments for all production systems; set reliability targets with product engineering and report performance to executive stakeholders
* Oversee monitoring and observability (CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, or equivalent) for proactive detection and rapid response
* Drive capacity planning so infrastructure scales efficiently with growth without compromising performance or cost targets
* Own the IT disaster recovery and business continuity plan; lead tabletop exercises and failover testing to validate recovery

**Strategy, Governance & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Develop and execute the multi-year technical operations roadmap aligned with product strategy and growth objectives
* Provide regular reporting to the SVP of Infrastructure Engineering and Technical Operations and executive leadership, including infrastructure health, cost, and initiative progress
* Lead vendor relationships for cloud, infrastructure tooling, and managed services, including contract negotiations, SLA management, and performance reviews
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and data privacy requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001) as they apply to infrastructure; partner with security on audit readiness
* Manage the technical operations budget, including headcount, tooling, and cloud spend, with accurate forecasting and variance analysis

Competencies

* Proven ability to build, scale, and retain high-performing technical teams across multiple geographies and time zones
* Executive presence; able to translate complex infrastructure concepts into clear narratives for C-suite and board audiences
* Strategic mindset balanced with operational discipline, from multi-year vision to day-to-day excellence
* Expert-level, current, hands-on command of AWS architecture, cloud networking, and security, sufficient to design and critique solutions and lead deep-dive troubleshooting in major incidents; not a people-management-only role
* Strong financial acumen managing multi-million-dollar cloud budgets and driving cost optimization without compromising reliability
* Skilled at leading globally distributed teams across multiple time zones
* Data-driven; uses metrics, SLOs, and KPIs to prioritize investments and communicate operational health
* Commitment to engineering excellence, blameless culture, and continuous learning
* Experience with AI based automation capabilities for system self-healing, stability and security.

**Position Type and Expected Hours of Work**

This is a full-time position (exempt where applicable) based in the United States or Canada. This position can be remote or hybrid. Standard hours are Monday through Friday during core business hours. Given the global nature of this role, flexibility in scheduling is expected to accommodate regular collaboration with the Pune, India team across significant time zone differences. Occasional evening availability for major deployments and scheduled maintenance windows may be required.

**Travel**

This position may require occasional travel within the United States and Canada, and possibly to India, to support vendor meetings, industry conferences, cross-functional leadership engagements, and business unit initiatives.

**Required Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; Master's or MBA preferred; equivalent experience considered
* 15+ years in technology operations, infrastructure engineering, or cloud operations, including 8+ years of hands-on production AWS design and operations and 5+ years leading technical teams in a director, senior director, head-of, or equivalent senior leadership role, regardless of title
* Experience managing distributed teams across multiple countries; experience overseeing staff in India strongly preferred
* Expert knowledge of AWS services including compute (EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda), storage (S3, EFS, EBS), databases (RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, ElastiCache), and security (IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, WAF, Shield, Network Firewall)
* Deep expertise in cloud and enterprise networking, including TCP/IP, DNS, BGP, IPsec VPN, load balancing, and TLS, with experience designing hybrid connectivity (Direct Connect, VPN) and multi-VPC/multi-account architectures at scale (VPC, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, Route 53, CloudFront)
* Hands-on proficiency with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK), CI/CD, and scripting (Python, Bash, or equivalent)
* Proven track record overseeing highly available, multi-region production systems with aggressive uptime and performance SLAs
* Experience managing cloud budgets, implementing FinOps, and presenting forecasts to executive leadership
* Experience with cloud security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, or PCI-DSS
* Experience owning observability platforms (Datadog, CloudWatch, Grafana, or equivalent) and driving a metrics-driven approach to operational health
* Experience owning disaster recovery and business continuity programs for cloud infrastructure, including regular testing and executive reporting
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (or equivalent) required; Advanced Networking – Specialty and Security – Specialty strongly preferred

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading technical operations at a SaaS or cloud-native company supporting enterprise customers with high availability and data security requirements
* Database reliability engineering experience, including RDS/Aurora tuning, failover testing, and backup/recovery validation
* Experience with enterprise network architecture beyond AWS, including SD-WAN, MPLS, next-gen firewalls, and ZTNA
* Familiarity with change management; ServiceNow or Jira Service Management a plus
* Experience in travel technology, hospitality, or other high-volume, customer-facing SaaS
* Exposure to ML/AI infrastructure, including data pipeline reliability and model serving on AWS

**Compensation**

The good faith compensation for this position is

United States: $160,000 - $180,000 USD

Compensation is determined based on several factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skill set, geographic location, as well as internal alignment and external benchmarks.

**Other Duties**

Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time according to business needs.

The performance of additional responsibilities if you are designated as a Data Protection Champion (DPC), Senior Information Risk Owner (SIRO) or Information Assurance Accounting Officer (IAAO).

**Work Environment**

This position operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms.

**AAP/EEO Statement**

Accommodations Plus International is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, creed, color, religion, alienage or national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, disability or handicap, sex, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic information, arrest record, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.

8cd6a7fb51050456d22f.title: Account Manager
8cd6a7fb51050456d22f.description:
***We always do the right thing, the right way.***
==================================================

**Job Title: Account Manager**

  
  

**Job ID: 763**

**Location:** California

**Department:** Sales

**Reports To:** Jesus Perea

**Job Type:** Full time

**Summary:**

At Aptiv Interconnect, we inspire the world's most innovative teams by doing the right thing, the right way. We are seeking a strategic, high-impact **Account Manager** to lead growth, retention, and executive-level alignment across our most critical customer partnerships.

The Account Manager serves as the primary strategic partner and customer advocate, orchestrating end-to-end account success, proactive value creation, and complex problem resolution. Operating at the intersection of commercial strategy and execution, this role collaborates closely with engineering, operations, and global logistics to align bespoke client requirements with operational capabilities. By transforming real-time buyer insights into continuous service and product improvements, the Account Manager safeguards mission-critical relationships, drives multi-year retention, and expands recurring revenue across Aptiv's enterprise portfolio.

**Leadership & Core Responsibilities:**

* **Account Strategy:** Define and execute comprehensive account growth strategies to maximize revenue, market share, and long-term customer lifetime value.

* Cross-Functional Orchestration: Lead internal cross-functional partners—including solutions engineering, customer success, marketing, and product teams—to deliver cohesive solutions and ensure seamless post-sale execution.

* Forecasting & Pipeline Ownership: Own territory and account revenue forecasting, delivering accurate weekly and quarterly projections to sales leadership.

* Client Advocacy: Act as the strategic voice of the customer internally, synthesizing client feedback and market trends to influence product roadmaps and service offerings.

* Mentorship & Culture: Mentor and support onboarding junior sales representatives and business development reps, fostering a collaborative, high-performance team culture.

* **Revenue Generation:** Meet or exceed designated quotas for annual recurring revenue (ARR), account expansion, renewals, and upselling/cross-selling products or services.
* **Contract Negotiation & Closing:** Lead contract renewals, master service agreements (MSAs), and commercial pricing negotiations to ensure favorable commercial terms and high retention rates.
* **Account Planning & Reviews:** Conduct structured quarterly business reviews (QBRs) and annual account planning sessions to align customer business objectives with company capabilities.

**Customer Relationship & Operations Management**

* **Onboarding & Adoption Alignment:** Partner with implementation and customer service teams to facilitate seamless customer handoffs, accelerating time-to-value and software/service adoption.
* **Escalation Management:** Serve as the senior escalation point for commercial disputes or critical service disruptions, driving rapid resolution while preserving customer trust.
* **Pipeline & Deal Administration:** Manage end-to-end operational workflows for renewals, expansions, and amendments, including quote generation, order processing, and billing coordination.
* **CRM Data Integrity:** Ensure timely, accurate upkeep of CRM records, logging all client correspondence, contract renewal dates, deal stages, and account activity logs.
* **Operational Reporting:** Produce regular cadence reports on account status, renewal risk, and customer operational metrics for leadership review.
* **Sales Enablement & Process Improvement:** Identify bottlenecks in the post-sales lifecycle and recommend process enhancements to standard operating procedures (SOPs), playbooks, and internal toolsets.

**Strategic Sales & Team Collaboration**

* **Account Expansion & Revenue Retention**: Analyze order patterns and client feedback to identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities, directly driving predictable recurring revenue and customer lifetime value.
* **Cross-Functional Business Alignment**: Partner with logistics, operations, and marketing teams to relay customer insights and streamline workflows, aligning day-to-day service execution with broader company growth goals.

**Education & Technical Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Finance, or a related field; equivalent practical experience accepted.
* **Relevant Track Record:** 5+ years of direct B2B sales, account management, or customer success experience, preferably within technology, or professional services environments.

**Preferred Skills & Qualifications**

* **Systems Proficiency**: Advanced proficiency in Salesforce, Microsoft office, Google Enterprise,
* **Analytics & Productivity Suites:** Working knowledge of business analytics and productivity software Microsoft Excel/PowerPoint, Google Workspace, Microsoft office, to analyze account utilization trends, create client-facing decks, and build financial justifications.

**Core Competencies**

* **Core Competencies**: High emotional intelligence and resilience under pressure, exceptional customer-centric problem solving, strong verbal and written communication, proactive cross-functional collaboration, and keen commercial acumen for account expansion.

4b229a653ab14e8950f1.title: Director, Merchandising Operations
4b229a653ab14e8950f1.description:
Parachute Health is transforming post-acute care as the leading digital ordering platform for medical equipment and supplies. We connect major health systems, health plans, and suppliers to help patients get the life-saving products they need at home. Since launching, we've connected 300,000+ clinicians and 3,000+ supplier locations across all 50 states and helped 15M+ patients. What started as a DME ePrescribing tool has become the order management platform of choice for home medical equipment.

Join our team and make a difference in patient care.

### **About the Role**

Parachute Health is building the definitive platform for ordering home medical equipment and supplies, helping clinicians and suppliers ensure that millions of patients each year receive the critical equipment and supplies they need. Our Merchandising Operations team (AKA "Merch") comprises Category Managers and Category Analysts who have three primary jobs: 1) build and maintain our catalog, 2) build and maintain our coverage criteria rules engine, and 3) partner with R&D to improve the tools and workflows behind both. Merch sits at the intersection of e-commerce, compliance, operations, and R&D, and its work is central to Parachute's core functionality. Clinicians use our catalog to find and order the right equipment for their patients, and suppliers rely on it to fulfill those orders. Our coverage criteria help users determine whether an item should be covered by the patient's insurance.

The Merch team's work is nuanced and detail-dense: we maintain information on tens of thousands of products so our software, and the people who use it, can rely on it. The 18-person team splits its time between project work, like building and redesigning product categories and turning payer rules into qualification questions, and ticket-based work, resolving complex requests escalated by our support and partner teams. Our work requires efficient operational processes and excellent documentation.

As Director of Merchandising Operations, you will own the team's operating framework: how work is planned, prioritized, and delivered, and how the team partners with other teams across Parachute. You'll coach and develop a mix of managers and individual contributors, lead the team's largest cross-functional projects, and serve as a close thought partner to the SVP of Merchandising.

The role is primarily internal (roughly 90%), with occasional customer communication, especially on escalations, that calls for a steady, polished hand.

### **What You'll Do**

* Be the operational leader for a highly motivated, highly capable team of managers and individual contributors: keep work running smoothly, protect morale, and learn and add to a team culture that is already strong.
* Drive key projects: stay close to the work and personally drive the team's largest, most complex projects, including timelines, dependencies, and cross-team communication.
* Know every team process end to end. Lead the creation, maintenance, and centralization of SOPs and shared resources; drive consistent practices, training, quality assurance, and continuous improvement across category teams.
* Collaborate with partner teams (e.g., Supplier Implementation, Product, Customer Success) so handoffs and shared processes run smoothly.
* Be a Merch advocate: make the team's work understandable and visible across the company.
* Run bandwidth and capacity planning; flag risks early and rebalance coverage.
* Define and report on team metrics (ticket throughput, SLAs, SKU work, rollout milestones).
* Own escalations as needed, partnering effectively with people at all levels across the organization.
* Support recruiting as needed, own onboarding for new merchants, and maintain continuity coverage for every category.

### **Requirements**

* 7+ years in operations, program delivery, or management or technology consulting (e.g., a Big Four or top-tier firm), with 3+ years managing and growing managers.
* Track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects using a clear, repeatable methodology.
* Data-driven: comfortable with capacity models, dashboards and prioritization trade-offs.
* Willingness to travel roughly once a quarter.

### **More About You**

* Passionate about improving patient outcomes in the healthcare space.
* Gets things done: drives work to completion and builds processes that stick.
* Thrives in complex, nuanced domains; quickly learns intricate systems (e.g., insurance coverage rules, product data) well enough to make sound calls.
* Clear, concise communicator who pushes back constructively and drives decisions.
* Sound compliance judgment: in a highly regulated industry, you know which issues to resolve and which to escalate.
* Track record of growing into increasing scope and responsibility.
* Nice to have: catalog, product data or e-commerce experience; healthcare, DME/HME or payer experience.

### **Benefits**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: Comprehensive plans with options for low-to-no-cost premiums
* Employer HSA Contribution: Company-funded contributions to your Health Savings Account
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Equity Incentive Plan
* Annual Company-Wide Bonus: Opportunity for up to 15% bonus based on company performance
* Remote-First Culture: We are remote-first with a dedicated NYC office and reimbursement options for co-working spaces
* Flexible Vacation Policy
* Summer Fridays: 5 additional Fridays off during the summer (separate from PTO)
* Home Office and Wellness Stipend
* Monthly Internet Stipend
* Annual Learning and Development Stipend

### **Base Salary Range (based on level and experience)**

$145,000-$180,000

a7e01eb58c2eec8f26c7.description:
**Position Overview**

The Part-Time Project Coordinator will provide administrative and project management support for a multi-year artifact conservation initiative involving Presidential Libraries and Museums. This position is ideal for an experienced professional with a background in museums, archives, libraries, conservation programs, or other cultural heritage organizations.

The successful candidate will help coordinate project activities, monitor milestones, maintain project documentation, prepare reports, and support communication among project stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Track project schedules, milestones, deliverables, and overall progress.
* Maintain organized project documentation and develop tracking tools and reporting templates.
* Coordinate meetings, maintain calendars, and communicate with project stakeholders.
* Assist with preparing statements of work and reviewing incoming proposals for completeness.
* Prepare narrative reports, budget summaries, and project progress updates.
* Develop presentations and supporting project materials.
* Coordinate logistics and scheduling for conservation forums and professional meetings.
* Assist with outreach communications and project-related correspondence.
* Monitor individual project activities and follow up with designated points of contact.
* Support the preparation and organization of project records and deliverables.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* At least 10 years of professional experience in the cultural sector, such as museums, libraries, archives, or comparable cultural heritage organizations.
* A college degree in a humanities-related discipline or equivalent relevant experience.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating projects, organizing schedules, and tracking multiple priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience preparing reports, presentations, project documentation, and professional correspondence.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting museum, archival, preservation, or conservation initiatives.
* Familiarity with project budgets, statements of work, and vendor coordination.
* Experience coordinating projects involving multiple locations and stakeholders.
* Experience organizing professional meetings, conferences, or forums.

  

**Important Employment Information**

**This opportunity is contingent upon contract award and successful verification of the candidate's qualifications.**

**ServCorp is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

Commercial Director

As a CBRE Commercial Director, you will assist with overseeing the department responsible for individual multi-disciplined real estate cost solutions for clients.

This job is part of the Building Consultancy function. They are responsible for specialist building services including surveying, inspections, and planning.

What You’ll Do:

* Provide formal supervision to employees. Monitor the training and development of staff. Conduct performance evaluations and coaching. Oversee the recruiting and hiring of new employees.
* Coordinate and manage the team's daily activities. Establish work schedules, assign tasks, and cross-train staff. Set and track staff and department deadlines. Mentor and coach as needed.
* Manage all aspects of commercial management including procurement, vendor management, scheduling, etc.
* Assist with designing and maintaining project-specific cost models to manage expenditures. Use cost model data to publish reports.
* Align cost model with stakeholder and client goals. Supply guidance and direction to achieve deliverables within the project scope.
* Establish a strategy to manage cash flow and project accruals.
* Implement commercial management strategies that identify goals and align with the project timelines.
* Assess the financial benefit and risk rating of projects to assess necessity. Develop and publish business cases to support recommendations.
* Apply a robust knowledge of multiple disciplines, the business, and key drivers which impact departmental and cross-functional performance.
* Identify and solve multi-dimensional, complex, operational, and organizational problems leveraging the appropriate resources within or outside the department.
* Significantly improves and changes existing methods, processes, and standards within job discipline.
* Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Persuade managers and other colleagues to take action while being guided by the organization's functional business plans. Negotiate with external partners, vendors, and customers of divergent interests to reach a common goal.

  

What You’ll Need:

* Bachelor's Degree preferred with 8-12 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
* Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention is preferred.
* Ability to lead the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations, and handle problems.
* Leadership skills to set, manage and achieve targets with a direct impact on multiple department results within a function.
* In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Expert organizational skills and an advanced inquisitive mindset.
* Sophisticated math skills. Ability to calculate mildly complex figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. 8c2c1bc43d8c7d069dd7.title: Customer Success Manager
8c2c1bc43d8c7d069dd7.description:
Department: Customer Success

Group: Operations

Reports to: Chief Operations Officer

Supervision: All Support Agents and Support Champions

Pay Range: $85K to $90K

**Overview**
------------

Yellow Labs Software, Inc is currently in the process of hiring a Customer Success Manager for their global Cloud ERP product, CustomBooks™. See more about us here: https://custombooks.com/ (https://custombooks.com/)

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is responsible for building strong relationships with customers, ensuring their satisfaction and success with our products, and free and paid services.

The CSM acts as a trusted advisor, guiding customers through onboarding, adoption, and retention phases, while identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling on their own. And ensuring the Support Agents that report to you are fully trained, identifying opportunities and selling paid services. The ultimate goal is to help customers achieve their business objectives and maximize the value of their investment in our solution, as well as identify opportunities for revenue for YLSI.

**Position Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

### **Customer Support**

* Lead the Customer Support team in helping our customer resolve issues.
* Monitor performance, train and mentor Support Agents.
* Suggest and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency and scalability.
* Handle higher level support issues, onboardings and training as needed.
* Meet, and ensure the Support team, meet all established Service Legal Agreement (SLA) times.
* Lead the First Level weekly meeting with the Support Team.
* Manage and monitor Tier 3 Slack channel and make sure threads are resolved - ticket created or if not a bug and new feature that it is addressed in the PM Review meeting.
* Ensure Zoho Desk tickets are created for any issue that is reported or discussed, and that all applicable Zoho Desk tickets are linked to Jira tickets.
* Lead and Host the PM Review weekly meeting with Support, Product, Operations and QA.
* Attend Product meetings as invited to discuss issues and projects, presenting your feedback and experience to help develop the best solution we can.
* Conduct Zoho Desk and Atlassian Jira searches for issue investigation
* Ensure you and your team are fully trained on all processes and services.
* Write Support related emails to customers for any issues or announcements as assigned.
* Provide billing backup as needed in Zoho Billing Add Ons.
* Create and maintain the Support Team Schedule ensuring all times are covered for established Support Hours.
* Manage and oversee Partner and Customizations Support, Payroll Onboarding and Support, Cancellations, Refunds processes and communications.

### **Paid/Professional Services: Support, Onboarding and Training****:**

* Work with the Sales, Operations, Training and the Support teams to guide new customers through paid support and/or paid training, paid onboarding and other services - ensuring a smooth and positive experience.
* Conduct the Support activity purchased, collaborating with other team members as needed.
* Provide resources to help customers understand and effectively use our products.
* Ensure the Paid Services processes are adhered to by all Support Agents and notify the COO of any issues with processes.
* Ensure you and your team are fully trained on Data Import data migrations and QBO and QBD conversions.

### **Upselling and Cross-Selling****:**

* Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling additional products and services.
* Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to drive expansion and revenue growth within existing accounts.
* Engage the Sales Team as needed to ensure opportunities for sales and revenue are not missed.

### **Relationship Management:**

* Develop and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with key customer stakeholders.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, addressing their needs and concerns.

### **Customer Advocacy****:**

* Act as the voice of the customer within the company, providing feedback to internal teams to improve products and services.
* Advocate for customer needs and work to resolve any issues that arise.

### **Customer Success Planning****:**

* Develop and execute customized customer success plans tailored to each customer's unique goals and objectives.
* Monitor customer health and engagement, identifying at-risk accounts and implementing strategies to mitigate churn.

### **Performance Monitoring and Reporting****:**

* Track and report on key metrics, such as customer satisfaction, product adoption, and retention rates. As well as the Support Agents' performance. Some metrics are done manually, some will be automated. Send out updated reports to the COO (and anyone else requested) monthly.
* Prepare regular reports and presentations for internal stakeholders and customers as assigned.
* Oversee Accounts Receivable and Collections tasks are done on time by the assigned Support Agents.

### **Customer Education and Community Building****:**

* Work with the Training Evangelist, Sales Manager, Marketing Team and COO to organize and facilitate customer training sessions, webinars, and user group meetings.
* Lead and manage Zoho Desk Knowledgebase and our Idea Exchange. Ensure KB Articles are written for any missing content, content is updated and videos are embedded. Also ensure SEO is done in each article. Ensure all Support Agents are creating and updating KB Articles.
* Foster a community among customers to share best practices and success stories.Identify happy customers for success stories and positive online reviews.

### **Continuous Improvement****:**

* Continuously gather customer feedback and work with product and engineering teams to improve product features and customer experience.
* Identify and communicate ways to improve processes.

Other duties as assigned.

**Position Requirements**

* Knowledge of business processes (sales, purchases, distribution, inventory, ecommerce, banking, business and financial reports) is mandatory to be successful in this role.
* Knowledge of accounting is strongly preferred.
* Strong and proven problem solving and troubleshooting skills for business operations.
* Experience managing a diverse and remote team of at least four +.
* Strong technical knowledge and acumen.
* Experience with Zoho Desk or other Support Desk platform required.
* Preferred: Atlassian Jira and Confluence, Slack, Asana, Zoom.
* Knowledge in other platforms we integrate with are preferred: ShipStation, Square, Stripe, Bill, Nuvei, Gusto, Avalara, Ledgersync.
* You will need to become an expert in the CustomBooks Cloud ERP software.
* Calm and professional demeanor, can handle high stress situations, and are great with individuals of other nationalities.
* Multi-tasker; high productivity threshold. Ability to work successfully remote and with others in many different timezones.
* Excellent communicator, high professionalism.
* Bachelor Degree in Business, or related degree Required.
* MBA or CPA preferred.

18a21d9ab8dddb05bbd8.title: Project Manager
18a21d9ab8dddb05bbd8.description:
Gigstreem is a US based national Internet Service Provider, serving Residential (Single Family, MDU) and Commercial (MTU) clients with technology solutions in markets across the country.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Project Manager leads end-to-end execution of residential capital project launches, including low voltage and network hardware installations for our managed WiFi solutions. Every project is delivered on time, within budget, and to client satisfaction.

The role works with cross-functional partners through every stage of the project lifecycle. That includes translating services sold into the Internal Statement of Work, developing and running the project plan, coordinating teams and clients, and leading the post-launch financial and operational review.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons.

Project Initiation & Planning

* Review and fully understand contract and pre-sale deliverables (Sales Budget, Scope of Work, Design, Circuit Provider plan, and revenue/conversion model) and translate services sold into the Internal Statement of Work.
* Develop comprehensive project plans for all assigned projects, including requirements, objectives, timelines, budgets, milestones, and resource allocation.
* Plan, manage, and execute projects involving low voltage cabling and network hardware installations.

Project Plan & Schedule Management

* Create and update the project plan and schedule covering all in-scope items, tasks, responsibilities, and due dates.
* Ensure each phase closes only after all deliverables are submitted.
* Ensure all tasks and activities are QC’ed by the appropriate subject matter expert (SME).
* Ensure punch-list completion and submission of all closeout materials.
* Schedule and run closeout meetings and guide stakeholders through the Lessons Learned process.

Team Leadership & Coordination

* Supervise and coordinate internal teams (CSM, Engineering, Design, Sales, Leadership), subcontractors, and vendors to achieve project goals.
* Delegate and assign responsibilities; direct, motivate, and manage all project work and resources, ensuring efficient use of company resources.
* Run regular project meetings and other communication channels so all stakeholders know their updates and responsibilities.
* Mentor and guide new hires and other members of the PM team.

Technical Management

* Oversee installation, testing, and commissioning of low voltage systems (structured cabling, fiber optics) and network hardware (routers, switches, access points).
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues during the project lifecycle, using company resources and management as needed.

Client Engagement

* Proficient in project management tools (MS Project, Smartsheet) and technical documentation software (AutoCAD).

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

* Excellent written and verbal communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with people at all levels inside and outside the company.

Preferred Qualifications

* CAPM, PMP, or equivalent project management certification.
* Networking certifications (e.g., CCNA, CompTIA Network+).

WHY JOIN GIGSTREEM

* Lead a high impact team at a growing, innovative company serving the multifamily and property management industry.

The Project Coordinator manages the daily scheduling and coordination of APEX technicians, equipment, and resources, serving as the key liaison between customers, field teams, Logistics, and Operations to ensure safe, efficient, and reliable execution of work.

The successful candidate will be highly organized, customer-focused, and able to balance multiple priorities while safely and efficiently coordinating APEX resources, supporting field teams, and ensuring reliable operations.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives under pressure, solves complex operational challenges, and is committed to safety, customer service, and operational excellence.

**What's In It for You:**

At Air Products we foster a culture of inclusion where every voice is heard, and everyone feels they belong and matter. Additionally, we offer competitive pay and excellent benefits for our employees. Check out some of our benefits below!

* Affordable medical, dental, and vision insurance available day one of employment
* 401(k) retirement savings plan with immediate vesting of company match and core contributions
* Paid vacation, holidays, and sick time
* Paid parental leave
* Adoption assistance
* Flexible Spending Accounts (medical, dependent daycare)
* Health Savings Account
* Life Insurance (AD&D), Supplemental AD&D
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

* Partner with the APEX Sales team to support customer opportunities from initial request through execution.

With its historical significance and landmarks, lively cultural offerings, and wide variety of atmospheres, Philadelphia is the perfect place to call home for work and play.

The University offers a competitive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare and tuition benefits for employees and their families, generous retirement benefits, a wide variety of professional development opportunities, supportive work and family benefits, a wealth of health and wellness programs and resources, and much more.

**Posted Job Title**

Clinical Research Project Manager B/C

**Job Profile Title**

Clinical Research Project Manager B

**Job Description Summary**

Clinical Research Project Manager B  
The Project Manager B will provide advanced project management and operational expertise in support of clinical research studies conducted within the Cardiovascular Division of PPMC. PM B position provides independent oversight of study operations, including project planning, team management, and study execution.
  
  
The Project Manager B will serve as the primary project manager for assigned studies, with accountability for study execution, operational planning, and overall performance including enrollment. This role will coordinate complex study activities across multidisciplinary teams including investigators, coordinators, core labs, and external collaborators. The Project Manager B will ensure studies are conducted in accordance with protocol requirements, sponsor expectations, and all applicable regulatory and institutional guidelines.  
  
Responsible for assisting with study coordination and recruitment for industry sponsored studies. Works directly with study physicians, research director and other research staff. Performs screening visits, consenting of participants, entering data into databases. Coordinate several investigational trials within the cardiovascular division of PPMC, instruct and support investigators and study staff on carrying out clinical protocol and other study related requirements  
  
Responsibilities include developing and maintaining detailed project plans and timelines, overseeing recruitment and enrollment strategies, and ensuring adherence to study milestones. PM B will lead track progress and proactively identify and resolve operational challenges. This individual will oversee compliance reviews and will ensure audit and inspection readiness across assigned studies. PM B will supervise and mentor research staff, and will provide guidance on day-to-day study operations, workload prioritization, and performance expectations. This role will promote consistency in processes, tools, and documentation, and contribute to the development and implementation of best practices and standard operating procedures. In collaboration with PPMC Administrative Director, the Project Manager B will obtain detailed knowledge of all components of trial protocols screening and enrolling patients, conducting follow-up activities, abstracting medical and demographics data from medical records, completing source documents and case report forms, data entry using various electronic data collection systems, managing the adverse event reporting process.
  
The Project Manager B functions with a high degree of independence in managing assigned projects but escalates strategic decisions and high-level study direction to senior leadership (e.g., Administrative Director, etc.).  
  
Clinical Research Project Manager C  
The Project Manager C will support the PPMC Cardiovascular Research and be responsible for day-to-day operations of multiple clinical research projects. The Research Project Manager will take leadership role in developing study documents managing the detailed operations of projects, coordinating activities in multiple studies, quality control and will lead project strategy. PM C will be required to ensure that studies/research are conducted safely and according to protocol, provide supervision to the teams conducting the study/interventions and collaborates with the funding agencies..
  
  
The Project Manager C will serve as the primary project manager for assigned studies, with accountability for study execution, operational planning, and overall performance including enrollment. This role will coordinate complex study activities across multidisciplinary teams including investigators, coordinators, core labs, and external collaborators.
  
  
This is a leadership position and will involve hiring, onboarding and oversee the detailed operations of clinical research activities including recruitment, conducting research visits, data entry. Coordinate investigational trials within the cardiovascular division of PPMC, instruct and support investigators and study staff on carrying out clinical protocol and other study related requirements  
  
PM C will lead track progress and proactively identify and resolve operational challenges. This individual will oversee compliance reviews and will ensure audit and inspection readiness across assigned studies. PM C will supervise and mentor research staff, and will provide guidance on day-to-day study operations, workload prioritization, and performance expectations. This role will promote consistency in processes, tools, and documentation, and contribute to the development and implementation of best practices and standard operating procedures.
  
  
The Project Manager C functions with a high degree of independence in managing assigned projects but escalates strategic decisions and high-level study direction to senior leadership (e.g., Administrative Director, etc.).

**Job Description**

**This position is contingent upon favorable funding.**

Clinical Research Project Manager B

**Job Responsibilities**

* Independently manage complex, multi-site cardiovascular clinical research studies in collaboration with the Principal Investigator, including daily operations, study coordination, recruitment/enrollment oversight, and troubleshooting in accordance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and all applicable regulatory requirements.
* Supervise, manage, and mentor study teams including onboarding, training, workload management, and performance oversight; develop and drive study timelines, recruitment strategies, and operational plans.
* Assist in research studies using approved protocols, according to GCP. Familiarize with all components of study protocols by review of study. Attend Investigators Meetings. Assure accurate, completion and updates of the Delegation of Duties and Authorized Signatures Form. Confer with the pharmacist as needed to assure the availability of study drug. Create, maintain research data, regulatory files.
* Timely initiation of screening, enrolling patients. Screen to identify potential patients for specific studies, determine patient eligibility by communicating with physicians, clinical staff and by reviewing medical records to validate potential patient data against Inclusion /Exclusion checklists. Recruit patients, explain protocol, consent forms. Assure original signed consents are maintained in the study binder. Complete screening/enrollment logs and submit to sponsor, as protocol.
* Complete all source documents and worksheets. Complete and/or enter all clinical record forms (CRFs). Create and maintain subject binders. Obtain records required to complete CRFs. Assure inclusion of enrollment information, research orders, and other communications are entered into the electronic medical record of each subject. Resolve data queries with sponsors/CROs.
* Support multicenter coordination and external collaborations, including communication with partner sites, core labs, and external stakeholders as applicable.
* Recruiting, training, and supervising full time research staff.
* Develop/ Help create EPIC Smart phrases.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree with 5-7 years of related experience or equivalent combination of education and experience is required. Master's degree and 3-5 years of experience preferred.

Clinical Research Project Manager C

**Job Responsibilities**

* Staff supervision: Assist and train direct and/or indirect research staff on procedures as required per protocol(s). Includes onboarding and training, data and lab management, protocol compliance and QC/QA, human subjects protection and GCP, and project assignments/staff mentoring/biannual performance appraisal completion.
* Independently manage complex, multi-site cardiovascular clinical research studies in collaboration with the Principal Investigator, including daily operations, study coordination, recruitment/enrollment oversight, and troubleshooting in accordance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and all applicable regulatory.

Assure inclusion of enrollment information, research orders, and other communications are entered into the electronic medical record of each subject. Resolve data queries with sponsors/CROs.
* Support multicenter coordination and external collaborations, including communication with partner sites, core labs, and external stakeholders as applicable.
* Recruiting, training, and supervising full time research staff.
* Develop/ Help create EPIC Smart phrases.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree and 7-10 years of related experience or equivalent combination of education and experience is required. Master's degree and 5-7 years of experience preferred.

Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

Perelman School of Medicine

$75,804.00 - $106,940.00 Annual Rate

Salary offers are made based on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, skills, and education as they directly relate to the requirements of the position, and in alignment with salary ranges based on external market data for the job’s level. The University of Pennsylvania is an equal opportunity employer. Candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, religion, creed, national origin (including shared ancestry or ethnic characteristics), citizenship status, age, disability, veteran status or any class protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

**Special Requirements**  
Background checks may be required after a conditional job offer is made. Consideration of the background check will be tailored to the requirements of the job.

**University Benefits**

* **Health, Life, and Flexible Spending Accounts**: Penn offers comprehensive medical, prescription, behavioral health, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits to protect you and your family’s health and welfare. You can also use flexible spending accounts to pay for eligible health care and dependent care expenses with pre-tax dollars.
* **Tuition**: Take advantage of Penn's exceptional tuition benefits. You, your spouse, and your dependent children can get tuition assistance here at Penn. Your dependent children are also eligible for tuition assistance at other institutions.
* **Retirement:** Penn offers generous retirement plans to help you save for your future. Penn’s Basic, Matching, and Supplemental retirement plans allow you to save for retirement on a pre-tax or Roth basis. Choose from a wide variety of investment options through TIAA and Vanguard.
* **Time Away from Work:** Penn provides you with a substantial amount of time away from work during the course of the year. This allows you to relax, take vacations, attend to personal affairs, recover from illness or injury, spend time with family—whatever your personal needs may be.
* **Long-Term Care Insurance:** In partnership with Genworth Financial, Penn offers faculty and staff (and your eligible family members) long-term care insurance to help you cover some of the costs of long-term care services received at home, in the community or in a nursing facility. If you apply when you’re newly hired, you won’t have to provide proof of good health or be subject to underwriting requirements. Eligible family members must always provide proof of good health and are subject to underwriting.
* **Wellness and Work-life Resources**: Penn is committed to supporting our faculty and staff as they balance the competing demands of work and personal life. That’s why we offer a wide variety of programs and resources to help you care for your health, your family, and your work-life balance.
* **Professional and Personal Development:** Penn provides an array of resources to help you advance yourself personally and professionally.
* **University Resources:** As a member of the Penn community, you have access to a wide range of University resources as well as cultural and recreational activities. Take advantage of the University’s libraries and athletic facilities, or visit our arboretum and art galleries. There’s always something going on at Penn, whether it’s a new exhibit at the Penn Museum, the latest music or theater presentation at the Annenberg Center, or the Penn Relays at Franklin Field to name just a few examples. As a member of the Penn community, you’re right in the middle of the excitement—and you and your family can enjoy many of these activities for free.
* **Discounts and Special Services**: From arts and entertainment to transportation and mortgages, you'll find great deals for University faculty and staff. Not only do Penn arts and cultural centers and museums offer free and discounted admission and memberships to faculty and staff. You can also enjoy substantial savings on other goods and services such as new cars from Ford and General Motors, cellular phone service plans, movie tickets, and admission to theme parks.
* **Flexible Work Hours:** Flexible work options offer creative approaches for completing work while promoting balance between work and personal commitments. These approaches involve use of non-traditional work hours, locations, and/or job structures.
* **Penn Home Ownership Services:** Penn offers a forgivable loan for eligible employees interested in buying a home or currently residing in West Philadelphia, which can be used for closing costs or home improvements.
* **Adoption Assistance:** Penn will reimburse eligible employees on qualified expenses in connection with the legal adoption of an eligible child, such as travel or court fees, for up to two adoptions in your household.

*To learn more, please visit:* *https://www.hr.upenn.edu/PennHR/benefits-pay*
